<![CDATA[import type { Metadata, Viewport } from "next";
import { Besley, Overpass_Mono, Public_Sans } from "next/font/google";
import { MOTION_SCRIPT } from "./tally/motion/mode";
import "./tally/tally.css";

const besley = Besley({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["500", "600", "700"],
  style: ["normal", "italic"],
  variable: "--font-besley",
});

const publicSans = Public_Sans({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "500", "600"],
  variable: "--font-public-sans",
});

const overpassMono = Overpass_Mono({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["400", "600"],
  variable: "--font-overpass-mono",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL("https://openlandingpage.vercel.app"),
  title: "TALLY — Sell your hours like your goods · Service Counter for Shopify",
  description:
    "The service-counter layer for small Shopify businesses. Turn standard product checkouts into booked appointments, repair intakes, partial deposits, and perforated bench-tracked claim tickets.",
};

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  themeColor: "#FAF4E8",
  colorScheme: "light",
};

export default function TallyLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html
      lang="en"
      className={`${besley.variable} ${publicSans.variable} ${overpassMono.variable}`}
      suppressHydrationWarning
    >
      <body className="tl-body">
        <script
          type={typeof window === "undefined" ? "text/javascript" : "text/plain"}
          suppressHydrationWarning
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: MOTION_SCRIPT }}
        />
        <noscript>
          <style>{`[data-reveal]{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important}`}</style>
        </noscript>
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/tally";

export function assetSrc(
  key: string,
  width: 800 | 1600,
  format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"
): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

type PictureProps = {
  assetKey: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
  sizes?: string;
  priority?: boolean;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
};

export function Picture({
  assetKey,
  alt,
  className,
  sizes = "(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw",
  priority,
  children,
}: PictureProps) {
  const webp800 = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!webp800) {
    return (
      <div
        className={`tl-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`}
        role="img"
        aria-label={alt}
        data-asset={assetKey}
      >
        {children ?? <span className="tl-mono">{assetKey}</span>}
      </div>
    );
  }
  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  const set = (f: "webp" | "avif") =>
    `${assetSrc(assetKey, 800, f)} 800w, ${assetSrc(assetKey, 1600, f)} 1600w`;
  return (
    <picture className={className}>
      <source type="image/avif" srcSet={set("avif")} sizes={sizes} />
      <img
        src={webp800}
        srcSet={set("webp")}
        sizes={sizes}
        width={w}
        height={h}
        alt={alt}
        loading={priority ? "eager" : "lazy"}
        fetchPriority={priority ? "high" : undefined}
        decoding="async"
        data-asset={assetKey}
      />
    </picture>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[import React from "react";
import { CounterStage } from "./counter/CounterStage";
import { RevenueCalculator } from "./counter/RevenueCalculator";
import { Reveal } from "./motion/Reveal";
import { SmoothScroll } from "./motion/SmoothScroll";
import { FaqSection } from "./sections/FaqSection";
import { Footer } from "./sections/Footer";
import { Header } from "./sections/Header";
import { Hero } from "./sections/Hero";
import { IntakeSection } from "./sections/IntakeSection";
import { MerchantStories } from "./sections/MerchantStories";
import { ServiceModes } from "./sections/ServiceModes";

export default function TallyPage() {
  return (
    <div className="tl-page">
      <SmoothScroll />
      <Header />

      <main id="main-content">
        <Hero />

        {/* The Signature Mechanic: Pinned & Interactive Perforated Ticket Runway */}
        <section
          id="ledger"
          className="tl-section tl-ledger-section"
          aria-labelledby="tl-ledger-heading"
        >
          <div className="tl-container tl-ledger-intro">
            <div className="tl-head-split">
              <Reveal as="h2" variant="mask" className="tl-h2">
                <span id="tl-ledger-heading" className="tl-mask-inner">
                  One claim ticket from checkout <em>to bench pickup.</em>
                </span>
              </Reveal>

              <Reveal as="p" variant="rise" delay={120} className="tl-section-lede">
                Track every order across four workbench stages. Adjust deposit splits and detach customer claim stubs.
              </Reveal>
            </div>
          </div>

          <CounterStage />
        </section>

        {/* Four Ways to Sell Time */}
        <ServiceModes />

        {/* Small Shopify Business Dossiers */}
        <MerchantStories />

        {/* Rate & Deposit Calculator + Merchant Plans */}
        <section
          id="calculator"
          className="tl-section tl-calc-section"
          aria-labelledby="tl-calc-heading"
        >
          <div className="tl-container">
            <div className="tl-section-head">
              <div className="tl-head-split">
                <Reveal as="h2" variant="mask" className="tl-h2">
                  <span id="tl-calc-heading" className="tl-mask-inner">
                    Priced like a shop ledger, <em>never a tax on your labor.</em>
                  </span>
                </Reveal>

                <Reveal as="p" variant="rise" delay={120} className="tl-section-lede">
                  No percentage cut on your hours. One flat monthly rate while recovering missed bench time.
                </Reveal>
              </div>
            </div>

            <RevenueCalculator />
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* § V · Counter Questions */}
        <FaqSection />

        {/* § VI · Open Your Counter */}
        <IntakeSection />
      </main>

      <Footer />
    </div>
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA[@import "tailwindcss";

@theme static {
  /* 5-Colour Pastel Shop Counter Palette */
  --color-paper: #FAF4E8;
  --color-mint: #C8E6D0;
  --color-blush: #F7C8B6;
  --color-lilac: #CFD6F6;
  --color-ink: #231F2B;

  /* Typography */
  --font-display: var(--font-besley), Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-public-sans), system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-overpass-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;

  /* Motion Tokens (motion-system.md §2) */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
  --ease-spring: linear(0, 0.35 8%, 0.82 20%, 1.06 30%, 1.02 42%, 0.99 58%, 1);

  --dur-instant: 90ms;
  --dur-fast: 180ms;
  --dur-base: 420ms;
  --dur-slow: 800ms;
  --dur-hero: 1200ms;

  --reveal-shift: 26px;
  --stagger: 70ms;
}

/* Scoped Custom Properties & Color-Mix Tints */
.tl-body {
  --tl-paper: #FAF4E8;
  --tl-mint: #C8E6D0;
  --tl-blush: #F7C8B6;
  --tl-lilac: #CFD6F6;
  --tl-ink: #231F2B;

  --font-display: var(--font-besley), Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-public-sans), system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: var(--font-overpass-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;

  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
  --ease-spring: linear(0, 0.35 8%, 0.82 20%, 1.06 30%, 1.02 42%, 0.99 58%, 1);

  --dur-instant: 90ms;
  --dur-fast: 180ms;
  --dur-base: 420ms;
  --dur-slow: 800ms;
  --dur-hero: 1200ms;

  --reveal-shift: 26px;
  --stagger: 70ms;

  --tl-paper-warm: color-mix(in srgb, #FAF4E8 88%, #F7C8B6);
  --tl-paper-mint: color-mix(in srgb, #FAF4E8 76%, #C8E6D0);
  --tl-paper-lilac: color-mix(in srgb, #FAF4E8 78%, #CFD6F6);
  --tl-ink-muted: color-mix(in srgb, #231F2B 74%, #FAF4E8);
  --tl-ink-soft: color-mix(in srgb, #231F2B 58%, #FAF4E8);
  --tl-rule: color-mix(in srgb, #231F2B 18%, #FAF4E8);
  --tl-rule-strong: #231F2B;

  background-color: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.tl-page {
  min-height: 100svh;
  position: relative;
}

.tl-container {
  width: min(1260px, calc(100% - 2 * clamp(16px, 4vw, 56px)));
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.tl-sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.tl-mono {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Skip Link & Focus Ring */
.tl-skip-link {
  position: fixed;
  top: 12px;
  left: 12px;
  z-index: 200;
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transform: translateY(-160%);
  transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-skip-link:focus {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.tl-body :focus-visible {
  outline: 2.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Scroll Progress Hairline */
.tl-progress-bar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 4px;
  z-index: 120;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #231F2B 10%, #FAF4E8);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.tl-progress-fill {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left center;
}

/* Header & Navigation */
.tl-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 90;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #FAF4E8 92%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-header-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  min-height: 70px;
}

.tl-brand-link {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.tl-logo-lockup {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.tl-mark {
  width: 42px;
  height: 30px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tl-logo-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1;
}

.tl-logo-word {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--tl-ink);
}

.tl-logo-sub {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.tl-desktop-nav {
  display: none;
}

@media (min-width: 980px) {
  .tl-desktop-nav {
    display: block;
  }
}

.tl-nav-pill-track {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(112px, 1fr));
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 3px;
}

.tl-nav-sliding-pill {
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  left: 3px;
  width: calc((100% - 6px) / 5);
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  transform: translate3d(calc(var(--pill-index, 0) * 100%), 0, 0);
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out-expo);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.tl-nav-link {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.tl-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.tl-queue-pill {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

@media (min-width: 1140px) {
  .tl-queue-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
  }
}

.tl-live-dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--tl-ink);
}

.tl-pause-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-instant) var(--ease-spring),
    background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-pause-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.tl-header-pause {
  display: none;
}

@media (min-width: 760px) {
  .tl-header-pause {
    display: inline-flex;
  }
}

.tl-pause-dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
}

.tl-pause-dot[data-paused="true"] {
  background: var(--tl-lilac);
}

.tl-header-cta {
  display: none;
}

@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .tl-header-cta {
    display: inline-flex;
  }
}

/* Mobile Menu Trigger & Dialog */
.tl-menu-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

@media (min-width: 980px) {
  .tl-menu-toggle {
    display: none;
  }
}

.tl-menu-bars {
  position: relative;
  width: 18px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--tl-ink);
}

.tl-menu-bars::before,
.tl-menu-bars::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  width: 18px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-menu-bars::before {
  top: -6px;
}

.tl-menu-bars::after {
  top: 6px;
}

.tl-mobile-dialog {
  width: min(420px, 92vw);
  margin: auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
}

.tl-mobile-dialog::backdrop {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #231F2B 55%, transparent);
}

.tl-mobile-drawer {
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}

.tl-mobile-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-bottom: 14px;
}

.tl-mobile-close {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-mobile-nav-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-mobile-nav-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.tl-mobile-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  border-top: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-top: 14px;
}

/* Shared Buttons */
.tl-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-instant) var(--ease-spring),
    background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.tl-btn-lg {
  padding: 13px 22px;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}

.tl-btn-primary {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
}

.tl-btn-secondary {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .tl-btn-primary:hover {
    background: var(--tl-mint);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }
  .tl-btn-secondary:hover {
    background: var(--tl-lilac);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }
}

.tl-icon-sm {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Section Head Typography */
.tl-section {
  padding-block: clamp(64px, 8vw, 112px);
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
}

.tl-section-head {
  margin-bottom: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
}

.tl-eyebrow-row {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  transform-origin: left center;
}

.tl-eyebrow-rule {
  width: 28px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  display: inline-block;
}

.tl-head-split {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .tl-head-split {
    grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 0.95fr;
    align-items: end;
    gap: 40px;
  }
}

.tl-h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.95rem, 3.6vw, 3.25rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  margin: 0;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.tl-h2 em,
.tl-hero-h1 em {
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.tl-section-lede {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.1vw, 1.12rem);
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin: 0;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.tl-mask-line {
  display: block;
  overflow: clip;
  padding: 0 0.1em 0.35em 0;
  margin-bottom: -0.22em;
}

.tl-mask-line:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  padding-bottom: 0.4em;
}

.tl-mask-inner {
  display: block;
}

/* Hero Section */
.tl-hero {
  padding-top: clamp(32px, 5vw, 68px);
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, color-mix(in srgb, #CFD6F6 48%, transparent), transparent 44%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 72%, color-mix(in srgb, #C8E6D0 44%, transparent), transparent 42%),
    var(--tl-paper);
}

.tl-hero-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 36px;
  align-items: center;
  padding-bottom: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px);
}

@media (min-width: 1040px) {
  .tl-hero-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1.06fr 0.94fr;
    gap: 48px;
  }
}

.tl-hero-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.tl-hero-h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.45rem, 5vw, 4.65rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.12;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  margin: 0 0 20px;
}

.tl-hero-lead {
  font-size: clamp(1.02rem, 1.15vw, 1.16rem);
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  max-width: 60ch;
  margin: 0 0 28px;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.tl-hero-ctas {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.tl-hero-archetypes {
  border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--tl-ink);
  padding-top: 16px;
}

.tl-hero-arch-label {
  display: block;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.tl-hero-arch-pills {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-arch-chip {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 13px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-instant) var(--ease-spring),
    background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-arch-chip[data-active="true"][data-tone="blush"] {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
}

.tl-arch-chip[data-active="true"][data-tone="mint"] {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
}

.tl-arch-chip[data-active="true"][data-tone="lilac"] {
  background: var(--tl-lilac);
}

/* Hero Right Counter Mat */
.tl-hero-mat {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 26px);
  position: relative;
}

.tl-hero-mat[data-tone="mint"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-mint);
}

.tl-hero-mat[data-tone="lilac"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-lilac);
}

.tl-mat-top {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.tl-mat-tag {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  display: block;
}

.tl-mat-shop-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.tl-bell-trigger {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform var(--dur-instant) var(--ease-spring);
}

.tl-bell-trigger:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
}

.tl-mat-bell-row {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

@media (min-width: 520px) {
  .tl-mat-bell-row {
    grid-template-columns: 156px 1fr;
  }
}

.tl-bell-svg {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 164px;
  height: auto;
}

.tl-bell-waves {
  opacity: 0.28;
  transition:
    opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-spring);
  transform-origin: center;
}

.tl-bell-svg[data-ringing="true"] .tl-bell-waves {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1.08);
}

.tl-bell-svg[data-ringing="true"] .tl-bell-plunger {
  transform: translateY(4px);
}

.tl-mat-sku {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-mat-service-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  margin: 4px 0 8px;
}

.tl-mat-slot-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 4px 9px;
}

/* Hero Mini Two-Part Ticket */
.tl-hero-ticket {
  display: grid;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

@media (min-width: 540px) {
  .tl-hero-ticket {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 2px 142px;
  }
}

.tl-hero-ticket-left {
  padding: 14px 16px;
  position: relative;
}

.tl-hero-ticket-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tl-rule);
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.tl-hero-ticket-rows {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.tl-hero-ticket-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-hero-ticket-seam {
  border-top: 2px dashed var(--tl-ink);
}

@media (min-width: 540px) {
  .tl-hero-ticket-seam {
    border-top: none;
    border-left: 2px dashed var(--tl-ink);
  }
}

.tl-hero-ticket-right {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  padding: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-spring);
}

.tl-hero-ticket[data-stamped="true"] .tl-hero-ticket-right {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
}

.tl-hero-stub-num {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.tl-hero-stamp-pos {
  position: absolute;
  right: 10px;
  bottom: 6px;
  width: 68px;
  height: 68px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Hero Bottom Strip */
.tl-hero-ledger-strip {
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
  padding-block: 22px;
}

.tl-strip-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
}

@media (min-width: 680px) {
  .tl-strip-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1040px) {
  .tl-strip-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  }
}

.tl-strip-item {
  border-left: 2px solid var(--tl-mint);
  padding-left: 14px;
}

.tl-strip-label {
  color: var(--tl-mint);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tl-strip-val {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--tl-paper);
}

/* § I · The Perforated Ticket Runway (Mechanic) */
.tl-ledger-section {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
}

.tl-ledger-intro {
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

@media (min-width: 1040px) and (min-height: 660px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html[data-tl-motion="live"] .tl-runway {
    min-height: 240vh;
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] .tl-runway-sticky {
    position: sticky;
    top: 82px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;
  }
}

.tl-stage-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

@media (min-width: 1080px) {
  .tl-stage-toolbar {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
}

.tl-archetype-tabs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .tl-archetype-tabs {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  }
}

.tl-arch-tab {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-instant) var(--ease-spring),
    background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-arch-tab[data-active="true"][data-tone="blush"] {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
}

.tl-arch-tab[data-active="true"][data-tone="mint"] {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
}

.tl-arch-tab[data-active="true"][data-tone="lilac"] {
  background: var(--tl-lilac);
}

.tl-arch-sku {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.tl-arch-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.tl-stop-stepper {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

@media (min-width: 680px) {
  .tl-stop-stepper {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, auto);
  }
}

.tl-stop-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-instant) var(--ease-spring),
    background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-stop-pill[data-state="past"] {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
}

.tl-stop-pill[data-state="active"] {
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
}

.tl-stop-num {
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 14%, transparent);
}

.tl-rail-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  height: 6px;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.tl-rail-fill {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  transform-origin: left center;
  transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

/* Main Stage Grid */
.tl-stage-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (min-width: 1040px) {
  .tl-stage-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 0.94fr 1.06fr;
  }
}

.tl-bench-panel {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: clamp(18px, 2.4vw, 28px);
}

.tl-bench-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.tl-badge-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-badge-pill[data-tone="blush"] {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
}

.tl-badge-pill[data-tone="lilac"] {
  background: var(--tl-lilac);
}

.tl-webhook-tag {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-bench-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.2vw, 1.85rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}

.tl-bench-summary {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.tl-live-note-card {
  background: var(--tl-paper-mint);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.tl-live-note-card[data-tone="blush"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
}

.tl-live-note-card[data-tone="lilac"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-lilac);
}

.tl-live-note-kicker {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tl-live-note-copy {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.tl-config-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  border-top: 1.5px solid var(--tl-rule);
  padding-top: 14px;
}

.tl-config-label {
  display: block;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tl-slot-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-slot-chip {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-slot-chip[data-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--tl-lilac);
}

.tl-config-row {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

.tl-deposit-pills {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-deposit-btn {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-deposit-btn[data-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
}

.tl-addon-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-addon-toggle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-addon-toggle[data-checked="true"] {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
}

.tl-addon-box {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tl-addon-text {
  flex: 1;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Right Column: Perforated Two-Part Ticket */
.tl-ticket-stage {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.tl-perforated-ticket {
  display: grid;
  position: relative;
}

@media (min-width: 680px) {
  .tl-perforated-ticket {
    grid-template-columns: 1.35fr 24px 0.85fr;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
}

.tl-ticket-bench-half {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: clamp(16px, 2.2vw, 24px);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.tl-ticket-top-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.tl-ticket-kicker {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  display: block;
}

.tl-ticket-shop {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 2px 0 0;
}

.tl-ticket-serial {
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
  padding: 4px 9px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-ticket-illustration-box {
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.tl-archetype-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

.tl-ticket-service-block {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.tl-ticket-sku-line {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.tl-ticket-service-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}

.tl-ticket-ledger-rows {
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 7px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.tl-ledger-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--tl-rule);
  padding-bottom: 5px;
}

.tl-ledger-row dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-ledger-row-total {
  border-bottom: none;
  border-top: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-top: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.96rem;
}

/* Circular Counter Stamp */
.tl-counter-stamp {
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
  position: absolute;
  right: 16px;
  bottom: 14px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(1.38) rotate(-16deg);
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-spring),
    opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.tl-counter-stamp[data-stamped="true"] {
  opacity: 0.94;
  transform: scale(1) rotate(-6deg);
}

.tl-stamp-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

/* Perforation Seam */
.tl-perforation-seam {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 22px;
}

.tl-perf-line {
  width: 100%;
  height: 2px;
  border-top: 2px dashed var(--tl-ink);
}

@media (min-width: 680px) {
  .tl-perf-line {
    width: 2px;
    height: 100%;
    border-top: none;
    border-left: 2px dashed var(--tl-ink);
  }
}

.tl-perf-scissors {
  position: absolute;
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 3px;
}

/* Detachable Customer Claim Stub */
.tl-ticket-customer-stub {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) rotate(0deg);
  transform-origin: top left;
  transition:
    transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-spring),
    background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-perforated-ticket[data-tone="mint"] .tl-ticket-customer-stub {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
}

.tl-perforated-ticket[data-tone="lilac"] .tl-ticket-customer-stub {
  background: var(--tl-lilac);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .tl-perforated-ticket[data-detached="true"] .tl-ticket-customer-stub {
    transform: translate3d(14px, 8px, 0) rotate(3.2deg);
  }
}

.tl-stub-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}

.tl-stub-state {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.tl-stub-Serial-big {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.tl-stub-slot {
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.tl-stub-turnaround {
  margin: -6px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-stub-financials {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-stub-pay-box {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.tl-stub-amount {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
}

.tl-stub-protection {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-stub-barcode {
  width: 100%;
  height: 28px;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
}

.tl-ticket-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

/* § II · Four Ways to Sell Time Bento */
.tl-modes-section {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
}

.tl-modes-bento {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
}

@media (min-width: 860px) {
  .tl-modes-bento {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

.tl-mode-card-inner {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: clamp(20px, 2.5vw, 30px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-mode-card-inner[data-tone="mint"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-mint);
}

.tl-mode-card-inner[data-tone="blush"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
}

.tl-mode-card-inner[data-tone="lilac"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-lilac);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .tl-mode-card-inner:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
  }
}

.tl-mode-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-mode-num {
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.tl-mode-kicker {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-mode-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0;
}

.tl-mode-desc {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.tl-mode-preview-box {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.tl-mode-switch-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
}

.tl-mode-switch-btn {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-mode-switch-btn[data-active="true"] {
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
}

.tl-mode-snippet {
  padding: 14px 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.tl-snippet-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.tl-snippet-meta,
.tl-snippet-station {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-snippet-bottom {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--tl-rule);
  padding-top: 8px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.tl-snippet-badge,
.tl-snippet-action {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  border: 1px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* § III · Merchant Stories & Marquee */
.tl-merchants-section {
  padding-top: 0;
  background: var(--tl-paper-lilac);
}

.tl-marquee-band {
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-block: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: clamp(48px, 6vw, 84px);
}

.tl-marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  width: max-content;
  gap: 28px;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html[data-tl-motion="live"]:not([data-tl-paused="true"]) .tl-marquee-track {
    animation: tl-marquee 42s linear infinite;
  }
  .tl-marquee-band:hover .tl-marquee-track,
  .tl-marquee-band:focus-within .tl-marquee-track {
    animation-play-state: paused;
  }
}

@keyframes tl-marquee {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(-50%, 0, 0);
  }
}

.tl-marquee-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.tl-marquee-dot {
  color: var(--tl-blush);
}

.tl-dossier-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
}

@media (min-width: 980px) {
  .tl-dossier-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }
}

.tl-dossier-inner {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .tl-dossier-inner:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
  }
}

.tl-dossier-media {
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
}

.tl-dossier-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

.tl-dossier-body {
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex: 1;
  gap: 14px;
}

.tl-dossier-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-dossier-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0;
}

.tl-dossier-stat-box {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.tl-dossier-inner[data-tone="blush"] .tl-dossier-stat-box {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
}

.tl-dossier-inner[data-tone="lilac"] .tl-dossier-stat-box {
  background: var(--tl-lilac);
}

.tl-dossier-stat-big {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tl-dossier-stat-label {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}

.tl-dossier-stat-sub {
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
}

.tl-dossier-quote {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-dossier-owner {
  margin-top: 8px;
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-dossier-btn {
  width: 100%;
}

/* Receipt Inspection Modal */
.tl-receipt-dialog {
  width: min(540px, 92vw);
  margin: auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
}

.tl-receipt-dialog::backdrop {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #231F2B 60%, transparent);
}

.tl-receipt-modal-card {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 24px;
  position: relative;
}

.tl-receipt-modal-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.tl-receipt-shop {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  margin: 4px 0;
}

.tl-receipt-sub {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-receipt-close {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-receipt-customer {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 1px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.tl-receipt-items {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px dashed var(--tl-ink);
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.tl-receipt-line {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 76px 1fr auto;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: baseline;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.tl-receipt-splits {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.tl-receipt-split-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.tl-receipt-footer-row {
  position: relative;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
}

.tl-receipt-note {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 72%;
}

/* § IV · Rate & Deposit Calculator + Plans */
.tl-calc-section {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
}

.tl-revenue-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 32px;
}

.tl-calc-board {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 32px);
}

@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .tl-calc-board {
    grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
    align-items: center;
  }
}

.tl-calc-sliders {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
}

.tl-kicker-tag {
  background: var(--tl-lilac);
  border: 1px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
}

.tl-calc-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  margin: 8px 0 0;
}

.tl-slider-field {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
}

.tl-slider-label-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tl-slider-readout {
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  border: 1px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.tl-range-input {
  width: 100%;
  accent-color: var(--tl-ink);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-slider-scale {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.tl-calc-receipt {
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 24px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
}

.tl-calc-receipt-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: var(--tl-mint);
  border-bottom: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, #FAF4E8 28%, transparent);
  padding-bottom: 10px;
}

.tl-calc-big-metric {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #FAF4E8 8%, #231F2B);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-mint);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 16px;
}

.tl-calc-big-label {
  color: var(--tl-blush);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.tl-calc-big-value {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 2.85rem);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
  display: block;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.tl-calc-per-mo {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.tl-calc-big-note {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, #FAF4E8 80%, #231F2B);
}

.tl-calc-breakdown {
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.tl-calc-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #FAF4E8 16%, transparent);
  padding-bottom: 6px;
}

.tl-calc-row dd {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--tl-mint);
}

/* Plans Grid */
.tl-plans-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
}

@media (min-width: 920px) {
  .tl-plans-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }
}

.tl-plan-card {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 24px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-plan-card[data-tone="mint"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-mint);
}

.tl-plan-card[data-tone="lilac"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-lilac);
}

.tl-plan-card[data-recommended="true"] {
  border-width: 3px;
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .tl-plan-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
  }
}

.tl-plan-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  border: 1px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.tl-plan-name {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.55rem;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.tl-plan-price-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.tl-plan-price {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 2.4rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
}

.tl-plan-ideal {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-plan-allowance {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-plan-features {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.tl-plan-feature-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-plan-check {
  font-weight: 700;
}

.tl-plan-cta {
  width: 100%;
}

/* § V · FAQ Accordion */
.tl-faq-section {
  background: var(--tl-paper-mint);
}

.tl-faq-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 32px;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .tl-faq-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr;
    gap: 48px;
  }
  .tl-faq-aside {
    position: sticky;
    top: 96px;
  }
}

.tl-faq-lede {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin: 14px 0 20px;
}

.tl-faq-badge-card {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
}

.tl-faq-badge-card p {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-faq-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.tl-faq-card {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.tl-faq-card[data-open="true"] {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
}

.tl-faq-q-wrap {
  margin: 0;
}

.tl-faq-trigger {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.tl-faq-q-left {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.tl-faq-tag {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-faq-q-text {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.tl-faq-icon {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-faq-card[data-open="true"] .tl-faq-icon {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  background: var(--tl-blush);
}

.tl-faq-answer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
}

.tl-faq-answer-grid[data-open="true"] {
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
}

.tl-faq-answer-inner {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.tl-faq-answer-copy {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 20px 18px;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

/* § VI · Open Your Counter Form & Trial Pass */
.tl-intake-section {
  background: var(--tl-paper);
}

.tl-intake-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 36px;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (min-width: 980px) {
  .tl-intake-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 0.88fr 1.12fr;
    gap: 48px;
  }
}

.tl-intake-lede {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  margin: 14px 0 24px;
}

.tl-intake-guarantees {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

.tl-guarantee-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
}

.tl-guarantee-dot {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 3px 7px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tl-guarantee-row p {
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-counter-form {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 30px);
}

.tl-form-top-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-form-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

@media (min-width: 620px) {
  .tl-form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

.tl-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.tl-field-full {
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .tl-field[data-invalid="true"] {
    animation: tl-shake 260ms var(--ease-out);
  }
}

@keyframes tl-shake {
  0%,
  100% {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  25% {
    transform: translateX(-6px);
  }
  75% {
    transform: translateX(6px);
  }
}

.tl-label {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.tl-input,
.tl-select,
.tl-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.94rem;
}

.tl-error {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  border: 1px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-form-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--tl-ink);
  padding-top: 16px;
}

.tl-form-footnote {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

/* Issued Trial Pass Success Card */
.tl-trial-pass-card {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  background: var(--tl-paper-mint);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 28px);
}

@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .tl-trial-pass-card {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 180px;
  }
}

.tl-pass-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.tl-pass-code {
  background: var(--tl-ink);
  color: var(--tl-paper);
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.tl-pass-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}

.tl-pass-disclaimer {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-pass-details {
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.tl-pass-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--tl-rule);
  padding-bottom: 6px;
}

.tl-pass-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
  padding-bottom: 0;
}

.tl-pass-row dt {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.tl-pass-row dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-pass-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.tl-pass-stub {
  background: var(--tl-blush);
  border: 2px dashed var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
}

.tl-pass-stub .tl-counter-stamp {
  position: static;
  width: 88px;
  height: 88px;
}

.tl-pass-stub-code {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

/* Footer */
.tl-footer {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  padding-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 80px);
  padding-bottom: 36px;
}

.tl-footer-top {
  display: grid;
  gap: 32px;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
}

@media (min-width: 920px) {
  .tl-footer-top {
    grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
    gap: 48px;
  }
}

.tl-footer-motto {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
  max-width: 42ch;
  margin: 12px 0 16px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.tl-footer-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--tl-mint);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tl-footer-nav-cols {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
}

@media (min-width: 600px) {
  .tl-footer-nav-cols {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }
}

.tl-footer-heading {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.tl-footer-links,
.tl-footer-meta-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tl-footer-link {
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.tl-footer-link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.tl-footer-meta-list {
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-footer-scene-wrap {
  border: 2px solid var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--tl-paper);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.tl-footer-scene-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html[data-tl-motion="live"]:not([data-tl-paused="true"]) .tl-ambient-sign {
    transform-origin: 456px 42px;
    animation: tl-sign-sway 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
}

@keyframes tl-sign-sway {
  from {
    transform: rotate(-1.6deg);
  }
  to {
    transform: rotate(1.6deg);
  }
}

.tl-footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  border-top: 1.5px solid var(--tl-ink);
  padding-top: 20px;
}

.tl-footer-copy {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--tl-ink-muted);
}

.tl-footer-bottom-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.tl-back-top {
  color: var(--tl-ink);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* Placeholder Box (assets.tsx) */
.tl-placeholder {
  background: var(--tl-paper-warm);
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--tl-ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  min-height: 180px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 16px;
}

/* Reveal & Load Choreography Rules (Active only under live motion & no-preference) */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html[data-tl-motion="live"] .tl-load-1 {
    animation: tl-rise-in var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out) 60ms both;
  }
  html[data-tl-motion="live"] .tl-load-2 .tl-mask-inner {
    animation: tl-mask-up var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo) 140ms both;
  }
  html[data-tl-motion="live"] .tl-load-3 .tl-mask-inner {
    animation: tl-mask-up var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo) 250ms both;
  }
  html[data-tl-motion="live"] .tl-load-4 {
    animation: tl-rise-in var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out) 360ms both;
  }
  html[data-tl-motion="live"] .tl-load-5 {
    animation: tl-rise-in var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out) 480ms both;
  }

  @keyframes tl-mask-up {
    from {
      transform: translate3d(0, 62%, 0);
    }
    to {
      transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes tl-rise-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translate3d(0, 20px, 0);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    }
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal] {
    transition:
      opacity var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out),
      transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out);
    transition-delay: calc(var(--delay, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--stagger));
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal][data-done="true"] {
    transition-delay: 0ms;
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="rise"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate3d(0, var(--reveal-shift), 0);
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="cascade"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate3d(0, var(--reveal-shift), 0) scale(0.97);
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="draw"]:not([data-in="true"]) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scaleX(0.15);
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="mask"] {
    overflow: clip;
    padding-bottom: 0.15em;
    margin-bottom: -0.15em;
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="mask"] .tl-mask-inner {
    transition: transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="mask"]:not([data-in="true"]) .tl-mask-inner {
    transform: translate3d(0, 68%, 0);
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="wipe"] .tl-wipe-child {
    transition:
      clip-path var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-in-out),
      transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out);
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="wipe"]:not([data-in="true"]) .tl-wipe-child {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0);
    transform: scale(1.05);
  }

  html[data-tl-motion="live"] [data-reveal="wipe"][data-in="true"] .tl-wipe-child {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

<![CDATA[import React from "react";

export function TallyMark({ className = "tl-mark" }: { className?: string }) {

      <line x1="6" y1="19" x2="20" y2="12" stroke="#231F2B" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />

        y1="4"
        x2="29"
        y2="28"
        stroke="#231F2B"
        strokeWidth="1.5"
        strokeDasharray="2.5 2.5"

}

export function TallyLogo({ className = "" }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className={`tl-logo-lockup ${className}`}>

        <span className="tl-logo-word">Tally</span>
        <span className="tl-logo-sub">COUNTER · POS</span>
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/counter/CounterStage.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArchetypeIllustration } from "../brand/Illustrations";
import { CounterStamp, ScissorsIcon } from "../brand/Logo";
import { ARCHETYPES, TICKET_STOPS } from "../content/data";
import { isMotionLive } from "../motion/mode";
import {
  activeStopIndex,
  type ArchetypeId,
  calculateTicketBreakdown,
  formatTicketSerial,
  isStubDetached,
  runwayProgress,
} from "./ticket";

const DEPOSIT_OPTIONS = [25, 50, 100] as const;

export function CounterStage() {
  const runwayRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const railFillRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const [archetypeId, setArchetypeId] = useState<ArchetypeId>("tailor");
  const [slotIndex, setSlotIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [depositPct, setDepositPct] = useState<number>(50);
  const [selectedAddOns, setSelectedAddOns] = useState<string[]>(["darn"]);
  const [stopIdx, setStopIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const [manualDetached, setManualDetached] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [manualStopOverride, setManualStopOverride] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const currentArchetype =
    ARCHETYPES.find((a) => a.id === archetypeId) ?? ARCHETYPES[0];

  // Listen for hero archetype switches
  useEffect(() => {
    const onSelectArchetype = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent<{ archetype?: ArchetypeId }>).detail;
      if (detail?.archetype) {
        const nextArch = ARCHETYPES.find((a) => a.id === detail.archetype);
        if (nextArch) {
          setArchetypeId(nextArch.id);
          setSlotIndex(0);
          setSelectedAddOns(nextArch.addOns[0] ? [nextArch.addOns[0].id] : []);
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("tally:archetype", onSelectArchetype);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("tally:archetype", onSelectArchetype);
  }, []);

  // Scroll-scrubbed runway driver (desktop fine pointer + motion live)
  useEffect(() => {
    const runwayEl = runwayRef.current;
    if (!runwayEl) return;

    let sectionTop = 0;
    let sectionHeight = 1;
    let vh = window.innerHeight;
    let rafId = 0;

    const measure = () => {
      const rect = runwayEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      sectionTop = rect.top + window.scrollY;
      sectionHeight = runwayEl.offsetHeight;
      vh = window.innerHeight;
    };

    const updateFromScroll = () => {
      rafId = 0;
      if (!isMotionLive()) return;
      const p = runwayProgress(window.scrollY, sectionTop, sectionHeight, vh);
      if (railFillRef.current) {
        railFillRef.current.style.transform = `scaleX(${p.toFixed(4)})`;
      }
      if (!manualStopOverride) {
        const nextStop = activeStopIndex(p, 4);
        setStopIdx((prev) => (prev === nextStop ? prev : nextStop));
        const shouldDetach = isStubDetached(p, false);
        setManualDetached((prev) => (prev === shouldDetach ? prev : shouldDetach));
      }
    };

    const onScroll = () => {
      if (!rafId) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(updateFromScroll);
      }
    };

    measure();
    updateFromScroll();

    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", measure, { passive: true });

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", measure);
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, [manualStopOverride]);

  const handleArchetypeChange = (id: ArchetypeId) => {
    const nextArch = ARCHETYPES.find((a) => a.id === id) ?? ARCHETYPES[0];
    setArchetypeId(id);
    setSlotIndex(0);
    setSelectedAddOns(nextArch.addOns[0] ? [nextArch.addOns[0].id] : []);
  };

  const toggleAddOn = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedAddOns((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  const handleStopSelect = (idx: number) => {
    setManualStopOverride(true);
    setStopIdx(idx);
    setManualDetached(idx === 3);
    if (railFillRef.current) {
      railFillRef.current.style.transform = `scaleX(${((idx + 1) / 4).toFixed(2)})`;
    }
  };

  const handleToggleTear = () => {
    setManualStopOverride(true);
    const next = !manualDetached;
    setManualDetached(next);
    if (next) {
      setStopIdx(3);
      if (railFillRef.current) {
        railFillRef.current.style.transform = "scaleX(1)";
      }
    }
  };

  const handleCarryToForm = () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("tally:select-config", {
        detail: {
          archetype: currentArchetype.id,
          depositPct,
        },
      })
    );
  };

  const addOnTotal = currentArchetype.addOns
    .filter((item) => selectedAddOns.includes(item.id))
    .reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0);

  const breakdown = calculateTicketBreakdown(
    currentArchetype.basePrice,
    depositPct,
    addOnTotal
  );
  const serial = formatTicketSerial(currentArchetype.id, slotIndex, depositPct);
  const currentStop = TICKET_STOPS[stopIdx] ?? TICKET_STOPS[0];
  const isTorn = manualDetached || stopIdx === 3;

  return (
    <div
      ref={runwayRef}
      className="tl-runway"
      data-stop={currentStop.step}
      data-detached={isTorn ? "true" : "false"}
    >
      <div className="tl-runway-sticky">
        <div className="tl-container">
          {/* Top Controls: Archetype Switcher + Stop Stepper */}
          <div className="tl-stage-toolbar">
            <div
              className="tl-archetype-tabs"
              role="tablist"
              aria-label="Small Shopify business service archetypes"
            >
              {ARCHETYPES.map((arch) => {
                const active = arch.id === currentArchetype.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={arch.id}
                    type="button"
                    role="tab"
                    aria-selected={active}
                    className="tl-arch-tab"
                    data-active={active ? "true" : "false"}
                    data-tone={arch.pastelTone}
                    onClick={() => handleArchetypeChange(arch.id)}
                  >
                    <span className="tl-mono tl-arch-sku">{arch.sku}</span>
                    <span className="tl-arch-name">{arch.name}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="tl-stop-stepper" role="group" aria-label="Service ticket lifecycle stages">
              {TICKET_STOPS.map((stop, idx) => {
                const state =
                  idx < stopIdx ? "past" : idx === stopIdx ? "active" : "future";
                return (
                  <button
                    key={stop.step}
                    type="button"
                    className="tl-stop-pill"
                    data-state={state}
                    aria-pressed={idx === stopIdx}
                    onClick={() => handleStopSelect(idx)}
                  >
                    <span className="tl-mono tl-stop-num">{stop.step}</span>
                    <span className="tl-stop-label">{stop.title}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Scroll Progress Rail */}
          <div className="tl-rail-wrap" aria-hidden="true">
            <div
              ref={railFillRef}
              className="tl-rail-fill"
              style={{ transform: `scaleX(${((stopIdx + 1) / 4).toFixed(2)})` }}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Live screen-reader status announcement */}
          <div className="tl-sr-only" aria-live="polite">
            {`Ticket ${serial} for ${currentArchetype.shopExample}: Stage ${currentStop.step} ${currentStop.title}. Deposit due now $${breakdown.depositDueNow}, balance at pickup $${breakdown.balanceAtPickup}.`}
          </div>

          {/* Main Workbench Grid: Left Configuration & Bench Feed + Right Two-Part Perforated Ticket */}
          <div className="tl-stage-grid">
            {/* Left Column: Active Bench Stage & Interactive Controls */}
            <div className="tl-bench-panel">
              <div className="tl-bench-header">
                <span className="tl-mono tl-badge-pill" data-tone={currentArchetype.pastelTone}>
                  STOP {currentStop.step} / 04 · {currentStop.tag}
                </span>
              </div>

              <h3 className="tl-bench-title">{currentStop.title}</h3>
              <p className="tl-bench-summary">{currentStop.summary}</p>

              <div className="tl-live-note-card" data-tone={currentArchetype.pastelTone}>
                <div className="tl-mono tl-live-note-kicker">
                  BENCH LOG · {currentArchetype.shopExample.toUpperCase()}
                </div>
                <p className="tl-live-note-copy">{currentArchetype.stopNotes[stopIdx]}</p>
              </div>

              {/* Interactive Configuration Controls */}
              <div className="tl-config-controls">
                <div className="tl-config-group">
                  <span className="tl-mono tl-config-label">SELECT SLOT</span>
                  <div className="tl-slot-grid" role="group" aria-label="Select booking slot">
                    {currentArchetype.slots.map((slot, idx) => (
                      <button
                        key={slot}
                        type="button"
                        className="tl-slot-chip"
                        data-selected={slotIndex === idx ? "true" : "false"}
                        aria-pressed={slotIndex === idx}
                        onClick={() => setSlotIndex(idx)}
                      >
                        {slot}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="tl-config-row">
                  <div className="tl-config-group">
                    <span className="tl-mono tl-config-label">DEPOSIT SPLIT</span>
                    <div className="tl-deposit-pills" role="group" aria-label="Checkout deposit percentage">
                      {DEPOSIT_OPTIONS.map((pct) => (
                        <button
                          key={pct}
                          type="button"
                          className="tl-deposit-btn"
                          data-selected={depositPct === pct ? "true" : "false"}
                          aria-pressed={depositPct === pct}
                          onClick={() => setDepositPct(pct)}
                        >
                          {pct === 100 ? "100% Prepay" : `${pct}% Deposit`}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="tl-config-group">
                    <span className="tl-mono tl-config-label">ADD-ONS</span>
                    <div className="tl-addon-list">
                      {currentArchetype.addOns.map((addon) => {
                        const checked = selectedAddOns.includes(addon.id);
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={addon.id}
                            type="button"
                            className="tl-addon-toggle"
                            data-checked={checked ? "true" : "false"}
                            aria-pressed={checked}
                            onClick={() => toggleAddOn(addon.id)}
                          >
                            <span className="tl-addon-box" aria-hidden="true">
                              {checked ? "✓" : "+"}
                            </span>
                            <span className="tl-addon-text">{addon.label}</span>
                            <span className="tl-mono tl-addon-price">+${addon.price}</span>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Right Column: The Perforated Two-Part Service Ticket */}
            <div className="tl-ticket-stage">
              <div
                className="tl-perforated-ticket"
                data-detached={isTorn ? "true" : "false"}
                data-tone={currentArchetype.pastelTone}
              >
                {/* Part A: Merchant Bench Tag (Left) */}
                <div className="tl-ticket-bench-half">
                  <div className="tl-ticket-top-row">
                    <div>
                      <span className="tl-mono tl-ticket-kicker">
                        BENCH TAG
                      </span>
                      <h4 className="tl-ticket-shop">{currentArchetype.shopExample}</h4>
                    </div>
                    <span className="tl-mono tl-ticket-serial">{serial}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="tl-ticket-illustration-box">
                    <ArchetypeIllustration archetype={currentArchetype.id} />
                  </div>

                  <div className="tl-ticket-service-block">
                    <div className="tl-mono tl-ticket-sku-line">
                      <span>SKU: {currentArchetype.sku}</span>
                      <span>{currentArchetype.benchStation}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="tl-ticket-service-title">{currentArchetype.serviceTitle}</div>
                  </div>

                  <dl className="tl-ticket-ledger-rows">
                    <div className="tl-ledger-row">
                      <dt>Slot</dt>
                      <dd className="tl-mono">{currentArchetype.slots[slotIndex]}</dd>
                    </div>
                    <div className="tl-ledger-row">
                      <dt>Base rate</dt>
                      <dd className="tl-mono">${currentArchetype.basePrice}.00</dd>
                    </div>
                    {currentArchetype.addOns
                      .filter((a) => selectedAddOns.includes(a.id))
                      .map((addon) => (
                        <div key={addon.id} className="tl-ledger-row">
                          <dt>+ {addon.label}</dt>
                          <dd className="tl-mono">${addon.price}.00</dd>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    <div className="tl-ledger-row tl-ledger-row-total">
                      <dt>Total value</dt>
                      <dd className="tl-mono">${breakdown.total}.00</dd>
                    </div>
                  </dl>

                  {/* Circular Counter Stamp (springs in when detached / Stop 04) */}
                  <CounterStamp
                    label={isTorn ? "READY · PICKUP" : "DEPOSIT LOCKED"}
                    sublabel={currentArchetype.shopExample.toUpperCase()}
                    stamped={isTorn}
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Perforation Seam with Scalloped Notches & Scissors Icon */}
                <div className="tl-perforation-seam" aria-hidden="true">
                  <span className="tl-notch tl-notch-top" />
                  <span className="tl-perf-line" />
                  <span className="tl-perf-scissors">
                    <ScissorsIcon />
                  </span>
                  <span className="tl-notch tl-notch-bottom" />
                </div>

                {/* Part B: Detachable Customer Claim Stub (Right) */}
                <div className="tl-ticket-customer-stub">
                  <div className="tl-stub-header">
                    <span className="tl-mono tl-stub-label">CLAIM STUB</span>
                    <span className="tl-mono tl-stub-state">
                      {isTorn ? "DETACHED · READY" : `STAGE ${currentStop.step}`}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="tl-stub-Serial-big tl-mono">{serial}</div>
                  <p className="tl-stub-slot">{currentArchetype.slots[slotIndex]}</p>
                  <p className="tl-stub-turnaround">{currentArchetype.turnaround}</p>

                  <div className="tl-stub-financials">
                    <div className="tl-stub-pay-box">
                      <span className="tl-mono">DUE NOW ({depositPct}%)</span>
                      <strong className="tl-mono tl-stub-amount">
                        ${breakdown.depositDueNow}.00
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                    <div className="tl-stub-pay-box tl-stub-pay-balance">
                      <span className="tl-mono">AT PICKUP</span>
                      <strong className="tl-mono tl-stub-amount">
                        ${breakdown.balanceAtPickup}.00
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="tl-stub-protection tl-mono">
                    ✓ {breakdown.noShowProtection} · SMS status link active
                  </div>

                  {/* Barcode bars in pure SVG */}
                  <svg
                    viewBox="0 0 180 32"
                    className="tl-stub-barcode"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  >
                    {[6, 12, 16, 24, 30, 34, 42, 48, 56, 62, 66, 74, 82, 88, 96, 102, 110, 118, 124, 132, 138, 146, 154, 160, 168].map(
                      (x, i) => (
                        <rect
                          key={x}
                          x={x}
                          y="2"
                          width={i % 3 === 0 ? "4" : "2"}
                          height="28"
                          fill="#231F2B"
                        />
                      )
                    )}
                  </svg>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Ticket Action Bar under the ticket */}
              <div className="tl-ticket-actions">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="tl-btn tl-btn-secondary"
                  onClick={handleToggleTear}
                >
                  <ScissorsIcon />
                  <span>
                    {isTorn ? "Re-attach Claim Stub" : "Stamp & Tear Claim Stub"}
                  </span>
                </button>

                <a
                  href="#open-counter"
                  className="tl-btn tl-btn-primary"
                  onClick={handleCarryToForm}
                >
                  <span>Use This Counter Setup</span>
                  <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { PLANS } from "../content/data";

export function RevenueCalculator() {
  const [weeklyBookings, setWeeklyBookings] = useState<number>(28);
  const [avgTicketPrice, setAvgTicketPrice] = useState<number>(85);
  const [depositPct, setDepositPct] = useState<number>(50);

  const recovery = calculateLedgerRecovery(
    weeklyBookings,
    avgTicketPrice,
    depositPct
  );

  const handleSelectPlan = (planId: PlanId) => {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("tally:select-config", {
        detail: {
          plan: planId,
          depositPct,
        },
      })
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="tl-revenue-wrap">
      {/* Interactive Ledger Calculator */}
      <div className="tl-calc-board">
        <div className="tl-calc-sliders">

          <div className="tl-slider-field">

            </div>
            <input
              id="tl-weekly-bookings"
              type="range"
