              className="tl-range-input"
            />
            <div className="tl-slider-scale tl-mono">
              <span>4 / wk (Solo studio)</span>
              <span>60 / wk (Busy shop)</span>
              <span>120 / wk (Multi-bay)</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="tl-slider-field">
            <div className="tl-slider-label-row">
              <label htmlFor="tl-avg-ticket">Average service ticket value</label>
              <output htmlFor="tl-avg-ticket" className="tl-mono tl-slider-readout">
                ${avgTicketPrice} / ticket
              </output>
            </div>
            <input
              id="tl-avg-ticket"
              type="range"
              min={25}
              max={300}
              step={5}
              value={avgTicketPrice}
              onChange={(e) => setAvgTicketPrice(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="tl-range-input"
            />
            <div className="tl-slider-scale tl-mono">
              <span>$25 (Hem / trim)</span>
              <span>$120 (Tune-up)</span>
              <span>$300 (Overhaul)</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="tl-slider-field">
            <div className="tl-slider-label-row">
              <label htmlFor="tl-calc-deposit">Checkout deposit collected upfront</label>
              <output htmlFor="tl-calc-deposit" className="tl-mono tl-slider-readout">
                {depositPct}% at checkout
              </output>
            </div>
            <input
              id="tl-calc-deposit"
              type="range"
              min={25}
              max={100}
              step={25}
              value={depositPct}
              onChange={(e) => setDepositPct(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="tl-range-input"
            />
            <div className="tl-slider-scale tl-mono">
              <span>25% hold</span>
              <span>50% standard</span>
              <span>75%</span>
              <span>100% prepay</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Receipt Output */}
        <div className="tl-calc-receipt" aria-live="polite">
          <div className="tl-mono tl-calc-receipt-top">
            <span>MONTHLY BENCH PROJECTION</span>
            <span>{recovery.monthlyBookings} TICKETS / MO</span>
          </div>

          <div className="tl-calc-big-metric">
            <span className="tl-mono tl-calc-big-label">
              RECOVERED BENCH REVENUE
            </span>
            <strong className="tl-calc-big-value">
              +${recovery.recoveredMonthlyRevenue.toLocaleString()}
              <span className="tl-calc-per-mo"> / mo</span>
            </strong>
            <p className="tl-calc-big-note">
              Protected by {depositPct}% upfront deposits and automated SMS reminders.
            </p>
          </div>

          <dl className="tl-calc-breakdown">
            <div className="tl-calc-row">
              <dt>Monthly Service Volume</dt>
              <dd className="tl-mono">${recovery.monthlyVolume.toLocaleString()}</dd>
            </div>
            <div className="tl-calc-row">
              <dt>Collected at Booking</dt>
              <dd className="tl-mono">${recovery.depositFloatCollected.toLocaleString()}</dd>
            </div>
            <div className="tl-calc-row">
              <dt>Tally Commission</dt>
              <dd className="tl-mono">$0 (Flat monthly tier)</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Three Flat-Rate Merchant Plans */}
      <div className="tl-plans-grid">
        {PLANS.map((plan) => {
          const isRecommended = recovery.recommendedPlan === plan.id;
          return (
            <article
              key={plan.id}
              className="tl-plan-card"
              data-tone={plan.pastel}
              data-recommended={isRecommended ? "true" : "false"}
            >
              <div className="tl-plan-top">
                <span className="tl-mono tl-plan-badge">
                  {isRecommended ? `★ RECOMMENDED · ${plan.badge}` : plan.badge}
                </span>
                <h3 className="tl-plan-name">{plan.name}</h3>
                <div className="tl-plan-price-row">
                  <span className="tl-plan-price">${plan.price}</span>
                  <span className="tl-mono tl-plan-cadence">{plan.cadence}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="tl-plan-ideal">{plan.idealFor}</p>
              </div>

              <div className="tl-mono tl-plan-allowance">{plan.includedTickets}</div>

              <ul className="tl-plan-features">
                {plan.features.map((feat) => (
                  <li key={feat} className="tl-plan-feature-item">
                    <span className="tl-plan-check" aria-hidden="true">
                      ✓
                    </span>
                    <span>{feat}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>

              <a
                href={`#open-counter`}
                className="tl-btn tl-btn-primary tl-plan-cta"
                data-plan={plan.id}
                onClick={() => handleSelectPlan(plan.id)}
              >
                <span>Start with {plan.name}</span>
                <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
              </a>
            </article>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<![CDATA[import { clamp, progress as calcProgress } from "../motion/math";

export type ArchetypeId = "tailor" | "cycle" | "kiln" | "watch";
export type PlanId = "counter" | "workshop" | "guild";

export const STUB_DETACH_THRESHOLD = 0.78;

const ARCHETYPE_DIGITS: Record<ArchetypeId, number> = {
  tailor: 1,
  cycle: 2,
  kiln: 3,
  watch: 4,
};

export function runwayProgress(scrollY: number, top: number, height: number, vh: number): number {
  const span = Math.max(height - vh, 1);
  return calcProgress(scrollY, top, top + span);
}

export function activeStopIndex(progress: number, stopCount = 4): number {
  const safeCount = Math.max(1, stopCount);
  const p = clamp(progress, 0, 1);
  return clamp(Math.floor(p * safeCount), 0, safeCount - 1);
}

export function stopLocalProgress(progress: number, index: number, stopCount = 4): number {
  const safeCount = Math.max(1, stopCount);
  const start = index / safeCount;
  const end = (index + 1) / safeCount;
  return calcProgress(clamp(progress, 0, 1), start, end);
}

export function isStubDetached(progress: number, manualDetached = false): boolean {
  return Boolean(manualDetached) || clamp(progress, 0, 1) >= STUB_DETACH_THRESHOLD;
}

export type TicketBreakdown = {
  total: number;
  depositDueNow: number;
  balanceAtPickup: number;
  noShowProtection: string;
};

export function calculateTicketBreakdown(
  basePrice: number,
  depositPct: number,
  addOnTotal = 0
): TicketBreakdown {
  const safeBase = Math.max(0, basePrice);
  const safeAddOn = Math.max(0, addOnTotal);
  const safePct = clamp(depositPct, 0, 100);
  const total = Math.round(safeBase + safeAddOn);
  const depositDueNow = Math.round((total * safePct) / 100);
  const balanceAtPickup = Math.max(0, total - depositDueNow);
  const showRate = safePct >= 100 ? 98 : safePct >= 50 ? 94 : safePct >= 25 ? 89 : 76;

  return {
    total,
    depositDueNow,
    balanceAtPickup,
    noShowProtection: `${showRate}% show rate`,
  };
}

export function formatTicketSerial(
  archetypeCode: ArchetypeId,
  slotIndex: number,
  depositPct: number
): string {
  const prefixDigit = ARCHETYPE_DIGITS[archetypeCode] ?? 1;
  const slotDigit = clamp(Math.round(slotIndex), 0, 9);
  const pctDigits = String(clamp(Math.round(depositPct), 0, 99)).padStart(2, "0");
  return `TLY-26-${prefixDigit}${slotDigit}${pctDigits}`;
}

export type LedgerRecovery = {
  monthlyBookings: number;
  monthlyVolume: number;
  depositFloatCollected: number;
  recoveredMonthlyRevenue: number;
  recommendedPlan: PlanId;
};

export function calculateLedgerRecovery(
  weeklyBookings: number,
  avgTicketPrice: number,
  depositPct: number
): LedgerRecovery {
  const safeWeekly = clamp(Math.round(weeklyBookings), 1, 500);
  const safePrice = clamp(Math.round(avgTicketPrice), 10, 2000);
  const safeDeposit = clamp(Math.round(depositPct), 0, 100);

  const monthlyBookings = safeWeekly * 4;
  const monthlyVolume = monthlyBookings * safePrice;
  const depositFloatCollected = Math.round((monthlyVolume * safeDeposit) / 100);

  // Typical un-deposited service no-show loss is ~14%; deposits recover 65%–88% of that loss.
  const baselineLoss = monthlyVolume * 0.14;
  const recoveryFactor = safeDeposit >= 50 ? 0.82 : safeDeposit >= 25 ? 0.68 : 0.35;
  const recoveredMonthlyRevenue = Math.round(baselineLoss * recoveryFactor);

  const recommendedPlan: PlanId =
    safeWeekly <= 20 ? "counter" : safeWeekly <= 60 ? "workshop" : "guild";

  return {
    monthlyBookings,
    monthlyVolume,
    depositFloatCollected,
    recoveredMonthlyRevenue,
    recommendedPlan,
  };
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/forms/CounterForm.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CounterStamp, ScissorsIcon } from "../brand/Logo";
import { ARCHETYPES, PLANS } from "../content/data";
import type { ArchetypeId, PlanId } from "../counter/ticket";
import {
  buildTrialPass,
  type CounterFormErrors,
  type CounterFormInput,
  type TrialPass,
  validateCounterForm,
} from "./validate";

export function CounterForm() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<CounterFormInput>({
    shopName: "",
    email: "",
    archetype: "tailor",
    plan: "workshop",
    depositPct: 50,
    serviceNote: "",
  });

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<CounterFormErrors>({});
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [trialPass, setTrialPass] = useState<TrialPass | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const shopNameRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const emailRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const serviceNoteRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement | null>(null);
  const successRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  // Sync from URL query params or custom events from the Counter / Pricing sections
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const qArch = params.get("archetype") as ArchetypeId | null;
      const qPlan = params.get("plan") as PlanId | null;
      if (qArch && ARCHETYPES.some((a) => a.id === qArch)) {
        setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, archetype: qArch }));
      }
      if (qPlan && PLANS.some((p) => p.id === qPlan)) {
        setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, plan: qPlan }));
      }
    } catch {}

    const onSelectConfig = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (
        e as CustomEvent<{
          archetype?: ArchetypeId;
          plan?: PlanId;
          depositPct?: number;
        }>
      ).detail;
      if (!detail) return;
      setForm((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        archetype: detail.archetype ?? prev.archetype,
        plan: detail.plan ?? prev.plan,
        depositPct: detail.depositPct ?? prev.depositPct,
      }));
    };

    window.addEventListener("tally:select-config", onSelectConfig);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("tally:select-config", onSelectConfig);
  }, []);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const validation = validateCounterForm(form);
    if (!validation.valid) {
      setErrors(validation.errors);
      if (validation.errors.shopName) {
        shopNameRef.current?.focus();
      } else if (validation.errors.email) {
        emailRef.current?.focus();
      } else if (validation.errors.serviceNote) {
        serviceNoteRef.current?.focus();
      }
      return;
    }

    setErrors({});
    setSubmitting(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const pass = buildTrialPass(form);
      setSubmitting(false);
      setTrialPass(pass);
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        successRef.current?.focus();
      }, 40);
    }, 320);
  };

  const handleCopyPass = async () => {
    if (!trialPass) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(trialPass.summaryText);
      setCopied(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      setCopied(true);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setTrialPass(null);
    setCopied(false);
    setErrors({});
  };

  if (trialPass) {
    return (
      <div
        ref={successRef}
        tabIndex={-1}
        className="tl-trial-pass-card"
        role="region"
        aria-label="Issued Merchant Trial Pass"
      >
        <div className="tl-pass-main">
          <div className="tl-pass-header">
            <span className="tl-mono tl-badge-pill" data-tone="mint">
              COUNTER TRIAL PASS ISSUED · LOCAL DEMO
            </span>
            <span className="tl-mono tl-pass-code">{trialPass.passCode}</span>
          </div>

          <h3 className="tl-pass-title">
            Your counter kit for <em>{trialPass.shopName}</em> is stamped and ready.
          </h3>
          <p className="tl-pass-disclaimer">
            This is a local interactive template demo—no network request was sent and nothing was stored on a server.
          </p>

          <dl className="tl-pass-details">
            <div className="tl-pass-row">
              <dt>Merchant Storefront</dt>
              <dd className="tl-mono">
                {trialPass.shopName} ({trialPass.email})
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div className="tl-pass-row">
              <dt>Counter Archetype</dt>
              <dd className="tl-mono">{trialPass.archetypeLabel}</dd>
            </div>
            <div className="tl-pass-row">
              <dt>Selected Ledger Tier</dt>
              <dd className="tl-mono">
                {trialPass.planLabel} · {trialPass.depositPct}% Checkout Deposit
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div className="tl-pass-row">
              <dt>Primary Bench Service</dt>
              <dd>{trialPass.serviceNote}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>

          <div className="tl-pass-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="tl-btn tl-btn-primary"
              onClick={handleCopyPass}
            >
              <span>{copied ? "Trial Pass Copied" : "Copy Trial Pass Brief"}</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="tl-btn tl-btn-secondary"
              onClick={handleReset}
            >
              <span>Configure Another Counter</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="tl-pass-stub">
          <CounterStamp
            label="TRIAL STAMPED"
            sublabel={trialPass.passCode}
            stamped={true}
          />
          <div className="tl-mono tl-pass-stub-code">{trialPass.passCode}</div>
          <div className="tl-mono tl-pass-stub-meta">14-DAY FREE BENCH TRIAL</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form
      className="tl-counter-form"
      aria-label="Open your service counter"
      noValidate
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
    >
      <div className="tl-form-top-bar">
        <span className="tl-mono">MERCHANT REQUISITION</span>
        <span className="tl-mono">14 DAYS FREE</span>
      </div>

      <div className="tl-form-grid">
        <div
          className="tl-field"
          data-invalid={errors.shopName ? "true" : "false"}
        >
          <label htmlFor="tl-shop-name" className="tl-label">
            Store or workshop name
          </label>
          <input
            ref={shopNameRef}
            id="tl-shop-name"
            name="shopName"
            type="text"
            aria-label="Shopify store or workshop name"
            placeholder="e.g. Hem & Haw Atelier"
            value={form.shopName}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, shopName: e.target.value }));
              if (errors.shopName) setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, shopName: undefined }));
            }}
            aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.shopName)}
            aria-describedby={errors.shopName ? "tl-err-shop" : undefined}
            className="tl-input"
          />
          {errors.shopName && (
            <p id="tl-err-shop" className="tl-error" role="alert">
              {errors.shopName}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div
          className="tl-field"
          data-invalid={errors.email ? "true" : "false"}
        >
          <label htmlFor="tl-merchant-email" className="tl-label">
            Merchant email
          </label>
          <input
            ref={emailRef}
            id="tl-merchant-email"
            name="email"
            type="email"
            aria-label="Merchant email address"
            placeholder="you@yourshop.co"
            value={form.email}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, email: e.target.value }));
              if (errors.email) setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, email: undefined }));
            }}
            aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)}
            aria-describedby={errors.email ? "tl-err-email" : undefined}
            className="tl-input"
          />
          {errors.email && (
            <p id="tl-err-email" className="tl-error" role="alert">
              {errors.email}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="tl-field">
          <label htmlFor="tl-form-archetype" className="tl-label">
            Service archetype
          </label>
          <select
            id="tl-form-archetype"
            name="archetype"
            value={form.archetype}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((prev) => ({
                ...prev,
                archetype: e.target.value as ArchetypeId,
              }))
            }
            className="tl-select"
          >
            {ARCHETYPES.map((arch) => (
              <option key={arch.id} value={arch.id}>
                {arch.name} ({arch.shopExample})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="tl-field">
          <label htmlFor="tl-form-plan" className="tl-label">
            Ledger tier
          </label>
          <select
            id="tl-form-plan"
            name="plan"
            value={form.plan}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, plan: e.target.value as PlanId }))
            }
            className="tl-select"
          >
            {PLANS.map((plan) => (
              <option key={plan.id} value={plan.id}>
                {plan.name} — ${plan.price}/mo ({plan.badge})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        className="tl-field tl-field-full"
        data-invalid={errors.serviceNote ? "true" : "false"}
      >
        <label htmlFor="tl-service-note" className="tl-label">
          Primary service or bench workflow
        </label>
        <textarea
          ref={serviceNoteRef}
          id="tl-service-note"
          name="serviceNote"
          rows={3}
          aria-label="What service or bench workflow are you putting on Shopify?"
          placeholder="e.g. Denim chain-stitch hemming, watch servicing, or wheel throwing classes..."
          value={form.serviceNote}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, serviceNote: e.target.value }));
            if (errors.serviceNote)
              setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, serviceNote: undefined }));
          }}
          aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.serviceNote)}
          aria-describedby={errors.serviceNote ? "tl-err-note" : undefined}
          className="tl-textarea"
        />
        {errors.serviceNote && (
          <p id="tl-err-note" className="tl-error" role="alert">
            {errors.serviceNote}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="tl-form-footer">
        <p className="tl-mono tl-form-footnote">
          LOCAL DEMO · NO NETWORK REQUEST
        </p>

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={submitting}
          className="tl-btn tl-btn-primary tl-submit-btn"
        >
          <ScissorsIcon />
          <span>
            {submitting ? "Stamping your trial pass…" : "Stamp & Issue Trial Pass"}
          </span>

    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/forms/validate.ts">
<![CDATA[import type { ArchetypeId, PlanId } from "../counter/ticket";

export type CounterFormInput = {
  shopName: string;
  email: string;
  archetype: ArchetypeId;
  plan: PlanId;
  depositPct: number;
  serviceNote: string;
};

export type CounterFormErrors = Partial<Record<keyof CounterFormInput, string>>;

const VALID_ARCHETYPES = new Set<ArchetypeId>(["tailor", "cycle", "kiln", "watch"]);
const VALID_PLANS = new Set<PlanId>(["counter", "workshop", "guild"]);
const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

export function validateCounterForm(input: CounterFormInput): {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: CounterFormErrors;
} {
  const errors: CounterFormErrors = {};
  const shopName = (input.shopName ?? "").trim();
  const email = (input.email ?? "").trim();
  const serviceNote = (input.serviceNote ?? "").trim();

  if (shopName.length < 2 || shopName.length > 80) {
    errors.shopName = "Enter your Shopify store or workshop name.";
  }

  if (!EMAIL_RE.test(email) || email.length > 120) {
    errors.email = "Enter a valid merchant email address.";
  }

  if (!VALID_ARCHETYPES.has(input.archetype)) {
    errors.archetype = "Choose a service counter archetype.";
  }

  if (!VALID_PLANS.has(input.plan)) {
    errors.plan = "Select a merchant ledger tier.";
  }

  if (serviceNote.length < 10 || serviceNote.length > 500) {
    errors.serviceNote = "Describe your primary service (at least 10 characters).";
  }

  return {
    valid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
    errors,
  };
}

export type TrialPass = {
  passCode: string;
  shopName: string;
  email: string;
  archetypeLabel: string;
  planLabel: string;
  depositPct: number;
  serviceNote: string;
  summaryText: string;
};

const ARCHETYPE_LABELS: Record<ArchetypeId, string> = {
  tailor: "Denim & Garment Atelier",
  cycle: "Bicycle Repair Bay",
  kiln: "Ceramic Kiln & Classes",
  watch: "Watch & Instrument Bench",
};

const PLAN_LABELS: Record<PlanId, string> = {
  counter: "Counter ($19/mo)",
  workshop: "Workshop ($49/mo)",
  guild: "Guild ($99/mo)",
};

export function buildTrialPass(input: CounterFormInput): TrialPass {
  const shopName = input.shopName.trim();
  const email = input.email.trim();
  const serviceNote = input.serviceNote.trim();
  const seedStr = `${shopName.toLowerCase()}|${email.toLowerCase()}|${input.archetype}|${input.plan}`;
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < seedStr.length; i++) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + seedStr.charCodeAt(i)) % 9000;
  }
  const num = 1000 + Math.abs(hash);
  const passCode = `TLY-26-${num}`;
  const archetypeLabel = ARCHETYPE_LABELS[input.archetype] ?? "Service Counter";
  const planLabel = PLAN_LABELS[input.plan] ?? "Workshop ($49/mo)";

  const summaryText = [
    `TALLY MERCHANT TRIAL PASS · ${passCode}`,
    `Storefront: ${shopName} (${email})`,
    `Counter Kit: ${archetypeLabel}`,
    `Ledger Tier: ${planLabel} · ${input.depositPct}% Deposit at Checkout`,
    `Service Workflow: ${serviceNote}`,
  ].join("\n");

  return {
    passCode,
    shopName,
    email,
    archetypeLabel,
    planLabel,
    depositPct: input.depositPct,
    serviceNote,
    summaryText,
  };
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/motion/math.ts">
<![CDATA[export function clamp(val: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, val));
}

export function lerp(start: number, end: number, t: number): number {
  const clamped = clamp(t, 0, 1);
  return start + (end - start) * clamped;
}

export function progress(val: number, start: number, end: number): number {
  if (end <= start) return 1;
  return clamp((val - start) / (end - start), 0, 1);
}

export function staggerDelay(index: number, stepMs = 70, maxMs = 420): number {
  return clamp(Math.max(0, index) * stepMs, 0, maxMs);
}

export function magneticOffset(delta: number, maxPull = 10, radius = 100): number {
  if (radius <= 0) return 0;
  const ratio = clamp(delta / radius, -1, 1);
  return ratio * maxPull;
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/motion/mode.ts">
<![CDATA[/**
 * Runs inline before first paint. Sets html[data-tl-motion="live"] only when JS is enabled
 * and prefers-reduced-motion is not "reduce". All hidden pre-reveal states and pinned scroll
 * stages are scoped under html[data-tl-motion="live"], guaranteeing a complete static page
 * when JS is disabled or reduced motion is active.
 */
export const MOTION_SCRIPT = `(function(){try{var d=document.documentElement;var q=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");var set=function(){d.dataset.tlMotion=q.matches?"static":"live"};set();q.addEventListener("change",set)}catch(e){}})();`;

export function isMotionLive(): boolean {
  return (
    typeof document !== "undefined" &&
    document.documentElement.dataset.tlMotion === "live" &&
    document.documentElement.dataset.tlPaused !== "true"
  );
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { isMotionLive } from "./mode";
import { magneticOffset } from "./math";

export type RevealVariant = "rise" | "mask" | "wipe" | "cascade" | "draw" | "stamp";

type ObserverCallback = () => void;
const callbacks = new WeakMap<Element, ObserverCallback>();
let sharedObserver: IntersectionObserver | null = null;

function getSharedObserver(): IntersectionObserver | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
    return null;
  }
  if (!sharedObserver) {
    sharedObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            const cb = callbacks.get(entry.target);
            if (cb) {
              cb();
              sharedObserver?.unobserve(entry.target);
              callbacks.delete(entry.target);
            }
          }
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px", threshold: 0.08 }
    );
  }
  return sharedObserver;
}

type RevealProps = {
  as?: "div" | "section" | "article" | "header" | "p" | "span" | "li" | "h2" | "h3";
  variant?: RevealVariant;
  delay?: number;
  index?: number;
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
};

export function Reveal({
  as: Tag = "div",
  variant = "rise",
  delay = 0,
  index = 0,
  className = "",
  children,
}: RevealProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;

    if (!isMotionLive()) {
      setInView(true);
      setDone(true);
      return;
    }

    const observer = getSharedObserver();
    if (!observer) {
      setInView(true);
      setDone(true);
      return;
    }

    let timerId: number | undefined;
    callbacks.set(el, () => {
      setInView(true);
      timerId = window.setTimeout(() => setDone(true), 1200);
    });
    observer.observe(el);

    return () => {
      observer.unobserve(el);
      callbacks.delete(el);
      if (timerId !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(timerId);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <Tag
      ref={ref as React.RefObject<never>}
      className={className}
      data-reveal={variant}
      data-in={inView ? "true" : "false"}
      data-done={done ? "true" : undefined}
      style={
        {
          "--delay": `${delay}ms`,
          "--i": index,
        } as React.CSSProperties
      }
    >
      {children}
    </Tag>
  );
}

export function CountUp({
  value,
  suffix = "",
  className = "",
}: {
  value: number;
  suffix?: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement | null>(null);
  const [display, setDisplay] = useState<number>(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || !isMotionLive()) {
      setDisplay(value);
      return;
    }

    let rafId = 0;
    const observer = getSharedObserver();
    if (!observer) {
      setDisplay(value);
      return;
    }

    callbacks.set(el, () => {
      const duration = 900;
      const start = performance.now();
      const tick = (now: number) => {
        const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
        setDisplay(Math.round(value * eased));
        if (t < 1) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        } else {
          setDisplay(value);
        }
      };
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    });
    observer.observe(el);

    return () => {
      observer.unobserve(el);
      callbacks.delete(el);
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={`tl-countup ${className}`}>
      <span className="tl-sr-only">
        {value}
        {suffix}
      </span>
      <span aria-hidden="true">
        {display}
        {suffix}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

export function Magnetic({
  children,
  className = "",
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const finePointer = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches;
    if (!finePointer) return;

    let rafId = 0;
    const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!isMotionLive()) return;
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
        const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
        const dx = magneticOffset(e.clientX - cx, 9, rect.width);
        const dy = magneticOffset(e.clientY - cy, 7, rect.height);
        el.style.transform = `translate3d(${dx.toFixed(1)}px, ${dy.toFixed(1)}px, 0)`;
      });
    };

    const onLeave = () => {
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      el.style.transform = "translate3d(0px, 0px, 0)";
    };

    el.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove, { passive: true });
    el.addEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave, { passive: true });

    return () => {
      el.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      el.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`tl-magnetic ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { clamp } from "./math";
import { isMotionLive } from "./mode";

export function SmoothScroll() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

    const progressEl = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-tl-progress]");
    const headerEl = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-tl-header]");
    const heroMatEl = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-tl-hero-mat]");

    let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
    let maxScroll = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
    let scrollRaf = 0;

    const refreshMaxScroll = () => {
      maxScroll = Math.max(1, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
    };

    const updateScrollUi = () => {
      scrollRaf = 0;
      const y = window.scrollY;
      const p = clamp(y / maxScroll, 0, 1);

      if (progressEl) {
        progressEl.style.transform = `scaleX(${p.toFixed(4)})`;
      }

      if (headerEl) {
        headerEl.dataset.scrolled = y > 56 ? "true" : "false";
        const delta = y - lastScrollY;
        if (y > 320 && delta > 8) {
          headerEl.dataset.compact = "true";
        } else if (delta < -6 || y <= 140) {
          headerEl.dataset.compact = "false";
        }
      }

      if (heroMatEl && isMotionLive() && y < 900) {
        const shift = clamp(y * 0.025, 0, 18);
        heroMatEl.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${shift.toFixed(1)}px, 0)`;
      }

      lastScrollY = y;
    };

    const onScroll = () => {
      if (!scrollRaf) {
        scrollRaf = requestAnimationFrame(updateScrollUi);
      }
    };

    refreshMaxScroll();
    updateScrollUi();

    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", refreshMaxScroll, { passive: true });

    // Dynamically mount Lenis only on desktop fine pointers with live motion
    let lenisCleanup: (() => void) | undefined;
    const fineDesktop = window.matchMedia(
      "(min-width: 960px) and (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)"
    ).matches;

    if (fineDesktop && isMotionLive()) {
      let cancelled = false;
      import("lenis")
        .then(({ default: Lenis }) => {
          if (cancelled || !isMotionLive()) return;
          const lenis = new Lenis({
            lerp: 0.11,
            smoothWheel: true,
          });
          let lenisRaf = 0;
          const frame = (time: number) => {
            if (isMotionLive()) {
              lenis.raf(time);
            }
            lenisRaf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          };
          lenisRaf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          lenisCleanup = () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(lenisRaf);
            lenis.destroy();
          };
        })
        .catch(() => {});

      return () => {
        cancelled = true;
        lenisCleanup?.();
        window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
        window.removeEventListener("resize", refreshMaxScroll);
        if (scrollRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(scrollRaf);
      };
    }

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", refreshMaxScroll);
      if (scrollRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(scrollRaf);
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}

export function MotionPauseButton({ className = "" }: { className?: string }) {
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => {
      setPaused(document.documentElement.dataset.tlPaused === "true");
    };
    sync();
    window.addEventListener("tally:motion-toggle", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("tally:motion-toggle", sync);
  }, []);

  const toggle = () => {
    const next = !paused;
    document.documentElement.dataset.tlPaused = next ? "true" : "false";
    setPaused(next);
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("tally:motion-toggle"));
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={toggle}
      className={`tl-pause-btn ${className}`}
      aria-pressed={paused}
      aria-label={paused ? "Resume counter motion" : "Pause counter motion"}
    >
      <span className="tl-pause-dot" data-paused={paused ? "true" : "false"} aria-hidden="true" />
      <span>{paused ? "Resume motion" : "Pause motion"}</span>
    </button>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { TallyLogo } from "../brand/Logo";
import { MotionPauseButton } from "../motion/SmoothScroll";

const NAV_ITEMS = [
  { href: "#ledger", label: "Ticket Runway" },
  { href: "#modes", label: "Service Modes" },
  { href: "#merchants", label: "Small Shops" },
  { href: "#calculator", label: "Rate Ledger" },
  { href: "#faq", label: "Questions" },
] as const;

export function Header() {
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [hoverIndex, setHoverIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDialogElement | null>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    if (!dialog) return;

    if (menuOpen) {
      if (!dialog.open) {
        try {
          dialog.showModal();
        } catch {
          dialog.setAttribute("open", "");
        }
      }
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    } else {
      if (dialog.open) {
        try {
          dialog.close();
        } catch {
          dialog.removeAttribute("open");
        }
      }
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    }

    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  const closeMenu = () => {
    setMenuOpen(false);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      triggerRef.current?.focus();
    }, 10);
  };

  const pillIndex = hoverIndex ?? activeIndex;

  return (
    <>
      <a href="#main-content" className="tl-skip-link">
        Skip to counter ledger
      </a>

      <div className="tl-progress-bar" aria-hidden="true">
        <div className="tl-progress-fill" data-tl-progress />
      </div>

      <header className="tl-header" data-tl-header data-scrolled="false">
        <div className="tl-container tl-header-inner">
          <a href="#top" className="tl-brand-link" aria-label="Tally home">
            <TallyLogo />
          </a>

          <nav className="tl-desktop-nav" aria-label="Primary navigation">
            <div
              className="tl-nav-pill-track"
              style={
                {
                  "--pill-index": pillIndex,
                } as React.CSSProperties
              }
            >
              <span className="tl-nav-sliding-pill" aria-hidden="true" />
              {NAV_ITEMS.map((item, idx) => (
                <a
                  key={item.href}
                  href={item.href}
                  className="tl-nav-link"
                  data-active={activeIndex === idx ? "true" : "false"}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHoverIndex(idx)}
                  onMouseLeave={() => setHoverIndex(null)}
                  onFocus={() => setHoverIndex(idx)}
                  onBlur={() => setHoverIndex(null)}
                  onClick={() => setActiveIndex(idx)}
                >
                  {item.label}
                </a>
              ))}
            </div>
          </nav>

          <div className="tl-header-actions">
            <span className="tl-mono tl-queue-pill" aria-label="4 live bench tickets">
              <span className="tl-live-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
              04 ON BENCH
            </span>

            <MotionPauseButton className="tl-header-pause" />

            <a href="#open-counter" className="tl-btn tl-btn-primary tl-header-cta">
              <span>Issue a Ticket</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
            </a>

            <button
              ref={triggerRef}
              type="button"
              className="tl-menu-toggle"
              aria-label={menuOpen ? "Close navigation" : "Open navigation"}
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((prev) => !prev)}
            >
              <span className="tl-menu-bars" data-open={menuOpen ? "true" : "false"} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <dialog
        ref={dialogRef}
        className="tl-mobile-dialog"
        aria-label="Mobile navigation"
        onCancel={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          closeMenu();
        }}
      >
        <div className="tl-mobile-drawer">
          <div className="tl-mobile-top">
            <TallyLogo />
            <button
              type="button"
              className="tl-mobile-close"
              aria-label="Close navigation menu"
              onClick={closeMenu}
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>

          <nav className="tl-mobile-nav-list" aria-label="Mobile navigation">
            {NAV_ITEMS.map((item, idx) => (
              <a
                key={item.href}
                href={item.href}
                className="tl-mobile-nav-link"
                onClick={() => {
                  setActiveIndex(idx);
                  setMenuOpen(false);
                }}
              >
                <span className="tl-mono">0{idx + 1}</span>
                <span>{item.label}</span>
              </a>
            ))}
          </nav>

          <div className="tl-mobile-footer">
            <MotionPauseButton />
            <a
              href="#open-counter"
              className="tl-btn tl-btn-primary"
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
            >
              <span>Issue a Ticket</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </dialog>
    </>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/sections/Hero.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { CounterBellSvg } from "../brand/Illustrations";
import { CounterStamp, ScissorsIcon } from "../brand/Logo";
import { ARCHETYPES } from "../content/data";
import type { ArchetypeId } from "../counter/ticket";
import { Magnetic } from "../motion/Reveal";

export function Hero() {
  const [activeArchId, setActiveArchId] = useState<ArchetypeId>("tailor");
  const [bellRinging, setBellRinging] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [heroStamped, setHeroStamped] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const activeArch =
    ARCHETYPES.find((a) => a.id === activeArchId) ?? ARCHETYPES[0];

  const handleRingAndStamp = () => {
    setBellRinging(true);
    setHeroStamped((prev) => !prev);
    window.setTimeout(() => setBellRinging(false), 700);
  };

  const handleQuickPick = (id: ArchetypeId) => {
    setActiveArchId(id);
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("tally:archetype", { detail: { archetype: id } })
    );
  };

  return (
    <section id="top" className="tl-hero" aria-labelledby="tl-hero-heading">
      <div className="tl-container tl-hero-grid">
        {/* Left Editorial Column */}
        <div className="tl-hero-copy">
          <h1 id="tl-hero-heading" className="tl-hero-h1">
            <span className="tl-mask-line tl-load-2">
              <span className="tl-mask-inner">Sell your hours</span>
            </span>
            <span className="tl-mask-line tl-load-3">
              <span className="tl-mask-inner">
                <em>like your goods.</em>
              </span>
            </span>
          </h1>

          <p className="tl-hero-lead tl-load-4">
            Turn Shopify checkouts into booked appointments, repair intakes, and bench claim tickets. Capture upfront deposits and sync seamlessly with Shopify POS.
          </p>

          <div className="tl-hero-ctas tl-load-4">
            <Magnetic>
              <a href="#ledger" className="tl-btn tl-btn-primary tl-btn-lg">
                <ScissorsIcon />
                <span>Try the Live Counter</span>
              </a>
            </Magnetic>

            <a href="#calculator" className="tl-btn tl-btn-secondary tl-btn-lg">
              <span>Calculate Recovery</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
            </a>
          </div>

          {/* Merchant Archetype Quick-Switcher */}
          <div className="tl-hero-archetypes tl-load-5">
            <span className="tl-mono tl-hero-arch-label">
              SHOP PREVIEW:
            </span>
            <div className="tl-hero-arch-pills" role="group" aria-label="Preview merchant counter">
              {ARCHETYPES.map((arch) => (
                <button
                  key={arch.id}
                  type="button"
                  className="tl-arch-chip"
                  data-active={arch.id === activeArch.id ? "true" : "false"}
                  data-tone={arch.pastelTone}
                  aria-pressed={arch.id === activeArch.id}
                  onClick={() => handleQuickPick(arch.id)}
                >
                  {arch.shopExample}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Interactive Counter Mat & Two-Part Claim Stub */}
        <div className="tl-hero-mat-wrap tl-load-5" data-tl-hero-mat>
          <div className="tl-hero-mat" data-tone={activeArch.pastelTone}>
            <div className="tl-mat-top">
              <div>
                <span className="tl-mono tl-mat-tag">
                  FRONT COUNTER MAT · {activeArch.city.toUpperCase()}
                </span>
                <div className="tl-mat-shop-title">{activeArch.shopExample}</div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="tl-bell-trigger"
                onClick={handleRingAndStamp}
                aria-pressed={heroStamped}
              >
                <span className="tl-mono">
                  {heroStamped ? "✓ Stamped · Ring Again" : "🔔 Ring Bell & Stamp"}
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="tl-mat-bell-row">
              <CounterBellSvg ringing={bellRinging} />
              <div className="tl-mat-bell-caption">
                <div className="tl-mono tl-mat-sku">{activeArch.sku} · ONLINE + POS</div>
                <p className="tl-mat-service-name">{activeArch.serviceTitle}</p>
                <span className="tl-mono tl-mat-slot-pill">
                  NEXT SLOT: {activeArch.slots[0]} · ${activeArch.basePrice}.00
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Hero Mini Two-Part Perforated Ticket */}
            <div
              className="tl-hero-ticket"
              data-stamped={heroStamped ? "true" : "false"}
            >
              <div className="tl-hero-ticket-left">
                <div className="tl-mono tl-hero-ticket-head">
                  <span>BENCH COPY · {activeArch.benchStation}</span>
                  <span>50% DEPOSIT</span>
                </div>
                <div className="tl-hero-ticket-rows">
                  <div className="tl-hero-ticket-row">
                    <span>Deposit at checkout</span>
                    <strong className="tl-mono">
                      ${Math.round(activeArch.basePrice * 0.5)}.00 PAID
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <div className="tl-hero-ticket-row">
                    <span>Due at pickup</span>
                    <strong className="tl-mono">
                      ${Math.round(activeArch.basePrice * 0.5)}.00 HELD
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <CounterStamp
                  label={heroStamped ? "BENCH READY" : "50% PAID"}
                  sublabel="SHOPIFY POS"
                  stamped={heroStamped}
                  className="tl-hero-stamp-pos"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="tl-hero-ticket-seam" aria-hidden="true" />

              <div className="tl-hero-ticket-right">
                <span className="tl-mono">CLAIM STUB</span>
                <strong className="tl-mono tl-hero-stub-num">
                  #TLY-{activeArch.sku.slice(-3)}
                </strong>
                <span className="tl-mono tl-hero-stub-turn">
                  {activeArch.turnaround}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom 4-up Ledger Strip */}
      <div className="tl-hero-ledger-strip">
        <div className="tl-container tl-strip-grid">
          <div className="tl-strip-item">
            <span className="tl-mono tl-strip-label">MIXED CARTS</span>
            <p className="tl-strip-val">Goods and service labor in one checkout</p>
          </div>
          <div className="tl-strip-item">
            <span className="tl-mono tl-strip-label">UPFRONT DEPOSITS</span>
            <p className="tl-strip-val">Cut no-shows with 25–100% upfront deposits</p>
          </div>
          <div className="tl-strip-item">
            <span className="tl-mono tl-strip-label">SHOPIFY POS</span>
            <p className="tl-strip-val">Scan stubs, pull parts, and print bench tags</p>
          </div>
          <div className="tl-strip-item">
            <span className="tl-mono tl-strip-label">ZERO COMMISSION</span>
            <p className="tl-strip-val">Flat monthly rate—keep 100% of your labor</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/sections/MerchantStories.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { MerchantDossierArt } from "../brand/Illustrations";
import { CounterStamp } from "../brand/Logo";
import { MERCHANT_STORIES, type MerchantStory } from "../content/data";
import { CountUp, Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";

const MARQUEE_TAGS = [
  "DENIM CHAIN-STITCH HEMMING",
  "BICYCLE DRIVETRAIN OVERHAULS",
  "WATCH CALIBER REGULATION",
  "GOODYEAR WELT RESOLING",
  "CERAMIC KILN FIRING",
  "STUDIO BENCH CLASSES",
];

export function MerchantStories() {
  const [activeStory, setActiveStory] = useState<MerchantStory | null>(null);
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDialogElement | null>(null);
  const lastTriggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    if (!dialog) return;

    if (activeStory) {
      if (!dialog.open) {
        try {
          dialog.showModal();
        } catch {
          dialog.setAttribute("open", "");
        }
      }
    } else if (dialog.open) {
      try {
        dialog.close();
      } catch {
        dialog.removeAttribute("open");
      }
    }
  }, [activeStory]);

  const closeReceipt = () => {
    setActiveStory(null);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      lastTriggerRef.current?.focus();
    }, 10);
  };

  return (
    <section
      id="merchants"
      className="tl-section tl-merchants-section"
      aria-labelledby="tl-merchants-heading"
    >
      {/* Ambient Service Ticker Band */}
      <div className="tl-marquee-band" aria-label="Supported small Shopify service categories">
        <div className="tl-marquee-track">
          {[...MARQUEE_TAGS, ...MARQUEE_TAGS].map((tag, idx) => (
            <span key={`${tag}-${idx}`} className="tl-mono tl-marquee-item">
              <span className="tl-marquee-dot" aria-hidden="true">
                ◆
              </span>
              {tag}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="tl-container">
        <div className="tl-section-head">
          <div className="tl-head-split">
            <Reveal as="h2" variant="mask" className="tl-h2">
              <span id="tl-merchants-heading" className="tl-mask-inner">
                Built for shops where the back room <em>is a workshop.</em>
              </span>
            </Reveal>

            <Reveal as="p" variant="rise" delay={120} className="tl-section-lede">
              Over 1,400 independent Shopify merchants run their workshops on Tally.
            </Reveal>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="tl-dossier-grid">
          {MERCHANT_STORIES.map((story, idx) => (
            <Reveal
              key={story.id}
              as="article"
              variant="cascade"
              index={idx}
              className="tl-dossier-card"
            >
              <div className="tl-dossier-inner" data-tone={story.pastel}>
                <Reveal as="div" variant="wipe" className="tl-dossier-media">
                  <div className="tl-wipe-child">
                    <MerchantDossierArt type={story.illustrationType} />
                  </div>
                </Reveal>

                <div className="tl-dossier-body">
                  <div className="tl-dossier-meta tl-mono">
                    <span>{story.category.toUpperCase()}</span>
                    <span>{story.location.toUpperCase()}</span>
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="tl-dossier-title">{story.shopName}</h3>

                  <div className="tl-dossier-stat-box">
                    <div className="tl-dossier-stat-big">
                      <CountUp value={story.metricValue} suffix={story.metricSuffix} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="tl-dossier-stat-copy">
                      <p className="tl-dossier-stat-label">{story.metricLabel}</p>
                      <p className="tl-mono tl-dossier-stat-sub">{story.secondaryStat}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <blockquote className="tl-dossier-quote">
                    “{story.quote}”
                    <footer className="tl-mono tl-dossier-owner">— {story.owner}</footer>
                  </blockquote>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="tl-btn tl-btn-secondary tl-dossier-btn"
                    aria-label={`Inspect Receipt #${story.receipt.serial}`}
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      lastTriggerRef.current = e.currentTarget;
                      setActiveStory(story);
                    }}
                  >
                    <span className="tl-mono">Receipt #{story.receipt.serial}</span>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </Reveal>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Accessible Receipt Inspection Modal Dialog */}
      <dialog
        ref={dialogRef}
        className="tl-receipt-dialog"
        aria-labelledby="tl-modal-receipt-title"
        onCancel={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          closeReceipt();
        }}
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (e.target === dialogRef.current) closeReceipt();
        }}
      >
        {activeStory && (
          <div className="tl-receipt-modal-card" data-tone={activeStory.pastel}>
            <div className="tl-receipt-modal-top">
              <div>
                <span className="tl-mono tl-receipt-serial">
                  COUNTER ARCHIVE · {activeStory.receipt.serial}
                </span>
                <h3 id="tl-modal-receipt-title" className="tl-receipt-shop">
                  {activeStory.shopName}
                </h3>
                <p className="tl-mono tl-receipt-sub">
                  {activeStory.receipt.date} · {activeStory.receipt.station}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="tl-receipt-close"
                aria-label="Close receipt dialog"
                onClick={closeReceipt}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="tl-receipt-customer tl-mono">
              CUSTOMER: {activeStory.receipt.customer}
            </div>

            <div className="tl-receipt-items">
              {activeStory.receipt.items.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.code} className="tl-receipt-line">
                  <span className="tl-mono tl-receipt-code">{item.code}</span>
                  <span className="tl-receipt-label">{item.label}</span>
                  <strong className="tl-mono tl-receipt-amt">{item.amount}</strong>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="tl-receipt-splits">
              <div className="tl-receipt-split-row">
                <span>Shopify Checkout Deposit</span>
                <strong className="tl-mono">{activeStory.receipt.depositPaid}</strong>
              </div>
              <div className="tl-receipt-split-row">
                <span>Counter Pickup Settlement</span>
                <strong className="tl-mono">{activeStory.receipt.balancePaid}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="tl-receipt-footer-row">
              <p className="tl-mono tl-receipt-note">✓ {activeStory.receipt.pickupNote}</p>
              <CounterStamp
                label="SETTLED IN POS"
                sublabel={activeStory.receipt.serial}
                stamped={true}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </dialog>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(tally)/tally/sections/ServiceModes.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { SERVICE_MODES } from "../content/data";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";

export function ServiceModes() {
  const [viewByCard, setViewByCard] = useState<Record<string, "storefront" | "pos">>({});

  const toggleView = (id: string, nextView: "storefront" | "pos") => {
    setViewByCard((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: nextView }));
  };

  return (
    <section id="modes" className="tl-section tl-modes-section" aria-labelledby="tl-modes-heading">
      <div className="tl-container">
        <div className="tl-section-head">
          <div className="tl-head-split">
            <Reveal as="h2" variant="mask" className="tl-h2">
              <span id="tl-modes-heading" className="tl-mask-inner">
                Every service format, <em>one counter ledger.</em>
              </span>
            </Reveal>

            <Reveal as="p" variant="rise" delay={120} className="tl-section-lede">
              Four flexible ways to sell time, services, and bench labor alongside physical inventory.
            </Reveal>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="tl-modes-bento">
          {SERVICE_MODES.map((mode, idx) => {
            const activeView = viewByCard[mode.id] ?? "storefront";
            return (
              <Reveal
                key={mode.id}
                as="article"
                variant="cascade"
                index={idx}
                className="tl-mode-card"
              >
                <div className="tl-mode-card-inner" data-tone={mode.pastel}>
                  <h3 className="tl-mode-title">{mode.title}</h3>
                  <p className="tl-mode-desc">{mode.description}</p>

                  {/* Storefront vs POS View Switcher */}
                  <div className="tl-mode-preview-box">
                    <div
                      className="tl-mode-switch-bar"
                      role="group"
                      aria-label={`${mode.title} preview mode`}
                    >
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="tl-mode-switch-btn tl-mono"
                        data-active={activeView === "storefront" ? "true" : "false"}
                        aria-pressed={activeView === "storefront"}
                        onClick={() => toggleView(mode.id, "storefront")}
                      >
                        Online Cart Line
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="tl-mode-switch-btn tl-mono"
                        data-active={activeView === "pos" ? "true" : "false"}
                        aria-pressed={activeView === "pos"}
                        onClick={() => toggleView(mode.id, "pos")}
                      >
                        Shopify POS Bench
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {activeView === "storefront" ? (
                      <div className="tl-mode-snippet" data-view="storefront">
                        <div className="tl-snippet-title">{mode.storefrontLine.title}</div>
                        <div className="tl-mono tl-snippet-meta">{mode.storefrontLine.meta}</div>
                        <div className="tl-snippet-bottom">
                          <span className="tl-mono tl-snippet-badge">
                            {mode.storefrontLine.depositBadge}
                          </span>
                          <strong className="tl-mono tl-snippet-price">
                            {mode.storefrontLine.price}
                          </strong>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="tl-mode-snippet" data-view="pos">
                        <div className="tl-mono tl-snippet-station">
                          {mode.posBenchLine.station}
                        </div>
                        <div className="tl-snippet-title">{mode.posBenchLine.status}</div>
                        <div className="tl-mono tl-snippet-meta">
                          {mode.posBenchLine.inventoryLink}
                        </div>
                        <div className="tl-snippet-bottom">
                          <span className="tl-mono tl-snippet-action">
                            ✓ {mode.posBenchLine.actionLabel}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Reveal>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>

class="tl-faq-aside"><h2 class="tl-h2" data-reveal="mask" data-in="false" style="--delay:0ms;--i:0"><span id="tl-faq-heading" class="tl-mask-inner">How Tally fits into your <em>existing Shopify stack.</em></span></h2><p class="tl-faq-lede" data-reveal="rise" data-in="false" style="--delay:120ms;--i:0">Native Online Store 2.0 app blocks and Shopify POS extensions. Zero Liquid code edits.</p><div class="tl-faq-badge-card" data-reveal="rise" data-in="false" style="--delay:200ms;--i:0"><span class="tl-mono">THEME COMPATIBLE</span><p>Works with Dawn, Prestige, Impulse, and custom themes out of the box.</p></div></div><div class="tl-faq-list"><div class="tl-faq-item" data-reveal="cascade" data-in="false" style="--delay:0ms;--i:0"><div class="tl-faq-card" data-open="true"><h3 class="tl-faq-q-wrap"><button type="button" class="tl-faq-trigger" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="tl-faq-panel-pos-sync" id="tl-faq-btn-pos-sync"><span class="tl-faq-q-left"><span class="tl-mono tl-faq-tag">SHOPIFY POS + ONLINE</span><span class="tl-faq-q-text">Does Tally work with both online Shopify and Shopify POS?</span></span><span class="tl-faq-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span></button></h3><div id="tl-faq-panel-pos-sync" role="region" aria-labelledby="tl-faq-btn-pos-sync" class="tl-faq-answer-grid" data-open="true"><div class="tl-faq-answer-inner"><p class="tl-faq-answer-copy">Yes. Customers can book online 24/7 or at your physical counter via Shopify POS. Both channels share the same real-time bench capacity and ticket ledger.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="tl-faq-item" data-reveal="cascade" data-in="false" style="--delay:0ms;--i:1"><div class="tl-faq-card" data-open="false"><h3 class="tl-faq-q-wrap"><button type="button" class="tl-faq-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="tl-faq-panel-deposits" id="tl-faq-btn-deposits"><span class="tl-faq-q-left"><span class="tl-mono tl-faq-tag">DEPOSITS &amp; BALANCES</span><span class="tl-faq-q-text">How do partial deposits and final pickup balances work?</span></span><span class="tl-faq-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span></button></h3><div id="tl-faq-panel-deposits" role="region" aria-labelledby="tl-faq-btn-deposits" class="tl-faq-answer-grid" data-open="false"><div class="tl-faq-answer-inner"><p class="tl-faq-answer-copy">You choose the deposit percentage (25%, 50%, or 100%). When work is stamped Ready, Tally texts a one-tap link for the remaining balance and any added parts.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="tl-faq-item" data-reveal="cascade" data-in="false" style="--delay:0ms;--i:2"><div class="tl-faq-card" data-open="false"><h3 class="tl-faq-q-wrap"><button type="button" class="tl-faq-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="tl-faq-panel-physical-goods" id="tl-faq-btn-physical-goods"><span class="tl-faq-q-left"><span class="tl-mono tl-faq-tag">MIXED CARTS</span><span class="tl-faq-q-text">Can customers buy physical products and services in the same cart?</span></span><span class="tl-faq-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span></button></h3><div id="tl-faq-panel-physical-goods" role="region" aria-labelledby="tl-faq-btn-physical-goods" class="tl-faq-answer-grid" data-open="false"><div class="tl-faq-answer-inner"><p class="tl-faq-answer-copy">Yes. Shoppers can add goods, attach service labor like hemming, and reserve fitting slots in a single Shopify checkout without split orders.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="tl-faq-item" data-reveal="cascade" data-in="false" style="--delay:0ms;--i:3"><div class="tl-faq-card" data-open="false"><h3 class="tl-faq-q-wrap"><button type="button" class="tl-faq-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="tl-faq-panel-rescheduling" id="tl-faq-btn-rescheduling"><span class="tl-faq-q-left"><span class="tl-mono tl-faq-tag">RESCHEDULE &amp; NO-SHOWS</span><span class="tl-faq-q-text">What happens when a customer reschedules or cancels?</span></span><span class="tl-faq-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span></button></h3><div id="tl-faq-panel-rescheduling" role="region" aria-labelledby="tl-faq-btn-rescheduling" class="tl-faq-answer-grid" data-open="false"><div class="tl-faq-answer-inner"><p class="tl-faq-answer-copy">Every claim stub includes a self-serve reschedule link. Within your custom cutoff window, deposits remain non-refundable to protect bench hours.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="tl-faq-item" data-reveal="cascade" data-in="false" style="--delay:0ms;--i:4"><div class="tl-faq-card" data-open="false"><h3 class="tl-faq-q-wrap"><button type="button" class="tl-faq-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="tl-faq-panel-theme-install" id="tl-faq-btn-theme-install"><span class="tl-faq-q-left"><span class="tl-mono tl-faq-tag">THEME 2.0 APP BLOCK</span><span class="tl-faq-q-text">Will Tally slow down my storefront or require code edits?</span></span><span class="tl-faq-icon" aria-hidden="true">+</span></button></h3><div id="tl-faq-panel-theme-install" role="region" aria-labelledby="tl-faq-btn-theme-install" class="tl-faq-answer-grid" data-open="false"><div class="tl-faq-answer-inner"><p class="tl-faq-answer-copy">No. Tally installs as a lightweight Theme 2.0 app block (&lt; 9 KB) that adopts your store styling automatically. Zero Liquid edits required.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section id="open-counter" class="tl-section tl-intake-section" aria-labelledby="tl-intake-heading"><div class="tl-container tl-intake-grid"><div class="tl-intake-copy"><h2 class="tl-h2" data-reveal="mask" data-in="false" style="--delay:0ms;--i:0"><span id="tl-intake-heading" class="tl-mask-inner">Stamp your first claim ticket <em>in ten minutes.</em></span></h2><p class="tl-intake-lede" data-reveal="rise" data-in="false" style="--delay:120ms;--i:0">Select your workshop archetype and deposit split to generate a live merchant trial pass.</p><div class="tl-intake-guarantees" data-reveal="rise" data-in="false" style="--delay:200ms;--i:0"><div class="tl-guarantee-row"><span class="tl-guarantee-dot" aria-hidden="true">01</span><div><strong>14-day free trial</strong><p>Full access on a draft or live theme.</p></div></div><div class="tl-guarantee-row"><span class="tl-guarantee-dot" aria-hidden="true">02</span><div><strong>Zero commission</strong><p>Keep 100% of your labor and parts revenue.</p></div></div><div class="tl-guarantee-row"><span class="tl-guarantee-dot" aria-hidden="true">03</span><div><strong>Free migration</strong><p>We import your existing service menu for free.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="tl-intake-form-col" data-reveal="cascade" data-in="false" style="--delay:140ms;--i:0"><form class="tl-counter-form" aria-label="Open your service counter" noValidate=""><div class="tl-form-top-bar"><span class="tl-mono">MERCHANT REQUISITION</span><span class="tl-mono">14 DAYS FREE</span></div><div class="tl-form-grid"><div class="tl-field" data-invalid="false"><label for="tl-shop-name" class="tl-label">Store or workshop name</label><input id="tl-shop-name" type="text" aria-label="Shopify store or workshop name" placeholder="e.g. Hem &amp;
